ra༅༅/ /bde legs su gyur cig /de yang 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun mkhyen pad+ma dkar po mchog dang / 6rdzo rgyan pad+ma'i rgyal tshab gter ston chen po reg 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po mchog gi bsnyen rdzogs zhu yul gyi mkhan po rje lha rtse ba ngag dbang bzang po'i sde/ paṇa chen lha dbang blo gros la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal slob tu gyur pa/ mkhas grub chen po ngag dbang sangs rgyas rdo rje mchog gi zhal snga nas mdzad pa can/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan skurdzongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa rabs kyi 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dga'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba de nyid/ bla ma phrin las rnam rgyal mchog gi thugs bskyed med du byung ba las bltams pa'i bal yul rang byung mchod rten rin po che'i nye 'dabs shrī gau tapa bud+dha wi ha ra'i gsung rab rgyun spel khang du/ las byed pa tshe dbang lha mo nas rtsis 'phrul nang

a ri bod kyi nang bstan dpe tshogs lte gnas khang dang / sku zhabs mkhas dbang jin si mitha mchog gi nas tshar grangs chig stong tham pa chos sku'i ring bsrel gsar du bskrun skabs/ 'brel yod thams cad la ma dkar gyi 'du byed pa po mkhan bshad sgrub bstan 'dzin ming pas/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i /sa kyi nags su/ bga' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dus chen khyad par can gyi nyin//ra skrun gsal bshad kyi tshul du bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga yaṃ//
go༅༅/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa rabs kyi 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dga'i 'khri shing zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

ra༅༅/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa rabs kyi 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dgazhi 'khri shing zhes bya ba/ dkar brgyud rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes nor bu'i me long yongs dag mkha' dang rab mnyam 'jug ngogs su/ /dus gsum rgyal mchog mkhyen brtse'i rang gzugs nye bar 'phos pa'i 'dzum rlabs kyis/ /smra ba kun

go༅༅/ /gyi rgyal por grub pa 'jam pa'i dgrangs zhes mtshan tsam gyi'ang //rmongs pa'i mun stug 'phrog par dpa' bas dge legs g.yo med sbyin gyur cig /mtshan 'dzin rlung gis nam yang mi g.yo shes rab zla ba 'bum gyi sde/ /gcig tu 'bril 'dra khrobo'i dbang po gtum 'a gad brgyangs sgrog pa ༅//mi shes gcod byed ral gri'i rgyun 'dzin don yod zhags 'phen blo

gros gnyen/ shes bya'i khams kun snang ba mdzad des bdag blo'i spobs pa mchog tu bsgrubs/ 2 /mdzes sdug mtshan dpe'i lang tsho bdo bas ri dwags rtags can snyems pa bcil/ /blo gros 'dab yangs dkyil 'khor rab rdzogs pad tshal rgyas la'ang lca ba bzhin/ /rgyud mangs sgra yis chos kun 'doms mkhas swa ra swa sdi bcom ldan mas/ /ngag la ngag gi 'dod pa rab 'jo'i mchog sbyin bkra shis gar gyis rol/ 3 /dpal ldan mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs rnam pa kun ldan mkha' klong yangs par rtag tu rgyu ba'i rol rtsed kyis/ /zag med chos kun longs su spyod pa'i gzi 'od mi zad dpal du 'bar bas sems dpa' che rnams dbyengs su 'jug pa'i go skabs 'byed/ /stobs bcu'i zer gyis bdud sde rgya mtshor mun pa spro byed spral pa'i gar gyis 'byung ldog la dges gnyis med gsung ba yongs

khye gtso/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi bdud rtsis 'byung po thams cad skal bzang mdzad po shākya seng ge'i zhabs mthil 'khor lor spyi bos 4 /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snying rje'i spyi gzugs sgrib bral spyan ras mkha' 'dra bas/ /ris med 'gro la rtag par gzigs pa drang srong chen po pad+ma'i phyag /'khor ra dang spyan yangs ut+pal rnam 'dren stong du chos pa'i gar/ /sras bcas rgyal kun spro dang bsdu ba'i phyi mo de la phyag bgyi'o/ 5 /de yi sgyu ma rnam par 'phrul re mig shar ba tsam gyi lus med bdag po'i lus 'jig pa/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog pad+ma dashar po'i 'phreng ba ni/ /mkhyen brtse'i nus mthu'i zil dngar spro ba 'dud/ snyo /zab rgyas thugs kyi bang mdzod snying po legs bshadare na chen rin thang can/ /don du gnyer la sbyin pa'i phyag sor lhod por brkyangs kyang g.yo ba

med/ /grags pa'i dbyangs snyan yoni tan ka bar dam du btags na'ang phyogs kyi cha/ /rang las shin tu ring bar rjes 'gro'i thams cad mkhyen zhabs bsngags par 'os/ 7 /mu med yid can phung po mtha' yas pa/ /srid gdung me lces gtsubs pas yongs dub rnams/ /bslu med skyabs kyi grib bsil dam pa'i shing / /dpag bsam dbang po'adi ste gnyis pa gang / 8 /gang gis rtogs brjod shel gyi tam+bu ra'i/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cu bskul ba'i blo/ /tshangs sras mgrin par rtse dgazhi rol rtsed las/ /gzhan du 'char ba'i go skabs ga la yod/ 9 /kun la byams brtse'i gzhan dbang can gyur pas/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar bkri slad/ /bde gshegs dus mkhyen rgyal po'i rnam thar bzhin/ /dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i mchod sprin spro/ 10 /blan tshig ga she'i 'dab ma rna lung las/ /ring du

ra༅༅/ /dpyangs pa'i rgyan la mtshar ci zhig /legs bshad nor bu'i 'phreng ba 'od 'bar bas/ /sa gsum snang bar byed pa 'di na jom/ 11 /tshig bcad dpal gyi rtsa ba rab brtan legs bshad sdong bu snying pos lcid/ /sdeb sbyor yal gzhi khyen yangs mngon mtho srid rtser lud pas brnag dasha' ba/ /mngon brjod 'dab ma'i dkyil 'khor lhun stug tshig rgyan me tog mdangs kyi bkra/ /don bzang 'bras ldan dpag bsam rtse dga'i 'khri shing 'di ni 'dir bskrun to/ 12 /gting mtha' mi mngon srid pa'i mtsho/ /sdug bsngal 'dzin khris gang ba las/ /'gro ba sgrol bzhed ded dpon sgo /blo gros 'di ste bsam par dasha'/ 'a /de ni bskal pa dpag med kyi'ang / /dpag med 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /'dzin ma zhes bya yoni tan 'dzin/ /phun tshogs mang ba'i bskal pa byung / yon /de ni bsod nams sngangs

pa'i gzugs/ /chu gter la ni zla ba bzhin/ :bas kyi mu khyud ces bya ba/ /gser gyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal 'brungs/ 15 /tshan po che yis stobs ldan pa'i/ /bu rno brgya phrag bcu'i thu bo/ /mig mi 'dzum zhes bsod nams stobs/ /mi dman mchog tu dge ba'ang byung / 16 /brgyad khri bzhi stong rgyal phran gyi/ /cad pan nor bu'i snod tshogs kyis/ /gang gi zhabs mthil bkrus pa'i lhag /'jig rten yongs kyi spyi bor 'ching / 17 /rgya mtsho'i rdul zhes bram ze'i rigs/ /sā la'i shing chen lta bu yang / /mdun na 'don gyi gtsor 'phags pa/ /rig byed pha rol brgal ba yod/ 18 /de sras thu bo rgya mtsho yi/ /snying po bzhin du snying po'i nor/ /rnam par brtas pa'i dbyed 'jo ba/ /srid mthar bgrod la nye bar byung / 19 /de ni tshogs gnyis yongs smin pas/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas su gyur pa'i mtshan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa

ra༅༅/ /rin chen gli /snying po zhes bya 'gro gsum skyabs/ 20 /de la mi bdag 'khor bcas kyis/ /legs byas mthu las 'ongs pa yi/ /mkho dgazhi yo byad de dang des/ /yun ring mchod cing bsnyen pa thob/ lto /yon tan rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i rdul/ /lhag pa'i thugs kyis sa skyong che/ /lan mang bskul ba'i nangs kyi mthar/ /zhing bzang 'dam pa'i blo gros skyes/ 22 /sangs rgyas zhing ni rnam mang po/ /'gag med 'char ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ /me long bkod la mnyam gzhag pas/ /sna tshogs zhing khams 'byams su klas/ 23 /de tshe nub phyogs bde ba can/ /dri med yon tan ldan der yab/ /mtha' bzhi rnam par gnon pa'i rgyal/ /tshe dpag med par lung bstan thob/ 24 /rgyal sras thu bo mig mi 'dzum/ /'jig rten dbang por grub pa gang / /sangs rgyas 'od zer kun nas

'phags/ /dpal brtsegs rgyal po zhes byar bstan/ 25 /de tshe de yis sems can khams/ /brtse bas skyabs phyir rang gi mtshan/ /spyan ras gzigs su byin rlabs par/ /legs zhes de bzhin gshegs pas bstosnad/ 26 /grangs med sems can rnam par grol ba'i sar bzhag kyang / /zad pa mi mnga'i 'khor ba 'di ko ci zhig 'dra/ /ji tsam spyad kyang chu yi srin po'i grong khyer che/ /'jig par gyur pa'i gnas skabs de ni su yis mthong / 27 /kye ma 'gro sgrol dam bca' 'di lta khur du lci/ /'bras bus dben pa'i ngal ba gang zhig su yis bsten/ /snyam nas sgyid lugs zhi bde'i ro la chags ma thag /yan lag mchog ni drag po'i grangs su bye bar gyur/ 28 /de nas de tshe 'od dpag med/ /dge ba'i bshes su 'ongs nas des/ /sems can khams la chos ston pa'i/ /bcu gcig zhal du byin gyis

ra༅༅/ /brlabs/ 29 /'jam gnyen phyag gi 'dab ma stong / /chos kyi 'khor lo bsgrur bar sprul/ /kun gzigs spyan gyi ri mo stong / /bskal pa bzang 'di'i sgron mar snang / 30 /spyan yangs pad+ma'i 'dab rtse las/ /zags pa'i chu thigs snying po can/ /'khor ba las sgrol bcom ldan ma/ /mched bcas skye dgazhi dpal du shar/ 7 /rgyal dbang kun gyi thugs rje'i cha/ /yongs su gang ba'i ri bong ༅/ /bdud rtsi'i zer brgya 'dzag pa 'di'i/ /'gran zlar 'os pa gang yang med/ 32 /sdug bsngal gsum gyis nyin dang mtshan/ /gtses pas nyen la mnyes gzhin pa/ /'di lta'i mtshan tsam bzung bas kyang / /bde bar gzhol mod som nyi tse/ 33 /nyin byed 'od kyi dra ba can/ kun gsal phang par nyal na yang / /sa la bkra shis padre'i tshal/ /rtse dgan thode la su zhig dogs/ 34 /gang dag phan

dang bde ba'i lam po che/ /ci yang 'byed la mchog tu mthu che ba/ /gru 'dzin bdag por skyabs su 'tshol ba gang / /de la mchog gi go 'phang shin tu nye/ 35 /de slad zhes par rab ldan mkhas pa rnams/ /kun tu dgazha ba'i tshal 'dir bstod bkur bsngags/ /rjed pa ri mor byed pa'i bsti stang gis/ /bde skyid 'dab brgya bskron la 'bad par rigs/ 36 /thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa rabs kyi 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dga'i 'khro shing las/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dang po'o// //stong nyid snying rje'i snying po rab zab dngos kun rjes su khyab par gdal/ /sna tshogs 'char ba'i 'khor lo chen po srid dang zhi ba'i dpal du 'khor/ /a ho a ho dag pa'i snang ba rab tu 'byams 'di su yis 'gog /mnyam nyid klong

ra༅༅/ /pa ngas bde chen 'byung gnas rta ljang dbang por 'dud/ 1 /ji ltar chu la lan tshwa dang / /sgong ba'i dbus su sgong skyes bzhin/ /las dang smon lam mthu brtas pas/ /mi mjed zhing 'di lhun gyis grub/ 2 /rlung me chu yi shing rta la/ /bcibs pa'i nor gyi blo gros ma/ /bcu gnyis kun da'i 'dab dbus su/ /rjes chags lhun po'i ge sar mtho/ 3 /dzam+bha bṛk+ṣa mtshon pa'i gling / /mthar byed phyogs su nyal ba la/ /dum bur 'byed pa'i ri mo drug /byed po'i pir gyis gsal bar bris/ 4 /rdo rje bye ma 'dren bzhin du/ /dal gyis 'bab pa'i sī ta'i klung / /rba rlabs so dkar 'dzum pa'i 'od/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lor 'grems pa bzhin/ 5 lda 'phreng kun+da'i phon po las/ /zags pa'i chu thigs mu tig tu/ /'khrul bar dogs pa de las ni/ /lus ngan phyogs kyi char bgrode pa/ 6 7myu la de

bde 'byung gi/ /gling zhes grags pa'i nga ro mtho/ /dam pa'i skye bos gang ba'i grong / /lha yul sa la babs pa 'dra/ 7 tadab brgyad pad+ma'i dbyebs ji lta'i/ /ze'u 'bra mu khyud ke la shas/ /kun tu ba〉sgor ba'i pad 'dab mtshams/ /dal 'bab 〈snas chus skusgongs su bcad/ 8 /'dab rer yul chen nyi ma'i grangs/ /de rer yul gardor bcu phrag bcu/ /mi bdag dgu bcu rtsa drug gis/ /chos bzhin skyong ba'i 'dun sa yod/ 9 /lte bar rin chen rang bzhin khang / /lhas brtsigs pho brang ka lā pa / shel gyi ba gam mthor brtsegs pa'i/ /'od kyis mtshan yang nyin bzhin dkar/ 10 /de mthar thub pa mchog gi grong / /rin chen pha gzhi bzhin ras las/ /sum rtsen snang cha 'phos 'dra ba'i/ /bkod legs 'dod pa'i dpal la spyod/ 11 /phyed na ma la ya'i skyed tshal/ /mig dang snying la bdud rtsi'i char/ /'bebs byed

ra༅༅/ /dpag bsam rkang 'thung nags/ /gzhan 'phral dbang du byed pa bzhin/ 12 /bung ba'i bu mo sbrang rtsis myos pa'i gar dang lhan cig mgrin pa'i gling bu glur blangs tshe/ /nyi zer thur mas 'dab brgya grol ba'i ke saji rnams dga' bas dal gyis rgod pa bzhin/ /'gram chang 'dzag pa'i lag ldan myos par 'dod pa'i tā la sbrang rtsi'i dbyangs kyis bslab pa 'doms/ /mdzes pa'i ri dwags mig 'bras 'khrul bas 'brug smras sgeg rnams gar stabs bsgyur la blta ba bzhin/ 'a /tsū tare 'khri shing 'bras bu'i khur lcis yongs su dub la ngal 'tsho gyis zhes yal gzhi lcugs mas brten pa bzhin/ /smra mkhas 'dab chags mu cor sgrogs pas drang por srong rnams sa mā dhi la snyoms par zhugs zhes bskal ba bzhin/ /rma bya'i mgrin ltar lta na sngag pa'i ku sha'i rtse mos chu zil 'thor ba ngan 'gro'i gnyid las bsrung ba

gusten 'os dga' ba'i skyed tshal sdug gu 'di ni brgya byin grong las brkus pa bzhin/ 14 /de dbus thar pa chen po yi/ /gzhal rin chen las grub rin thang can/ /mu thi la yi mchod sdong bzhin/ 15 /rdo rje'i mtshon chas bdud dpung gi/ /ri bo shig pa'i mthu ma'i 'phral/ /tsan+d+ra r+bha dras bskrun pa yod/ 16 /sku gsung thugs dang bde chen gyi/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub phyogs kyi chos/ /) ma ji drozhin rab tu 'bar/ 17 /gru bzhi rab mnyam logs bzhi ru/ /gnyis 'thung brdzis pa'i ral pa can/ /drag po'i rtsal gyi bteg pa'i/ 18 /gser gyi rang bzhin twa ra ṇa/ /brtsegs ma mngon mthos 'jig rten gsum/ /mnan dogs mes po grogs sbyon

ra༅༅/ /pa'i/ /pho nyar ba dan darkan po bsgrengs/ 19 /rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan ma la/ /'gran 'dod nor bu'i rnga yab gzugs/ /me long nang du mdzes ngom pa'i/ /snyan pa phyogs bcur dril bus bsgrags/ 20 /an+da rnyil gyi har mi la/ /gnas pa bum pa'i bcud dag gis/ /myos rnams gzhan du lhung ba las/ /bsrung phyir ka ba'i gsham nas bskor/ lto /'khor lo bum bzang rnga bo che/ /byang chub shing ster rang rang gi/ /'khor bcas dpal gyi dbyed thams cad/ /skal bar ldan la cig car 'jo/ 22 /kha dog lnga ldan dbang po'i gzhu/ /rtsig pa'i zol gyis 'phreng ba la/ /rin chen snam bu phrag dog gis/ /steng nas bskor zhing mnan pa snyam/ nar /mukyi ka 'phreng do shal la/ /chags pa'i dar gyi chun phyang rnams/ /zla tshes dkar pos mtshams sbyor nas/ /me tog 'phreng tshogs rnams dang

sbrel/ 24 /rgya phubs pad+ma'i yu ba la/ /cung zad 'phyang ba'i ba ku lī/ /ri dwags mtshan ma dang bral ba'i/ /zla ba gzhan yang bsgrigs pa 'dra/ 25 /kra ma shir+ṣa'i mda' yab rtse/ /mkha' dang 'dres pa'i 'od snang la/ /lta byed mig mi 'dzum pa'i bu/ /gar bcas me tog char du 'bebs/ 26 /'od kyi rba rlabs mkhar 'khyud pa'i/ /rin chen gtso bo'i gtsug tor rtses/ /steng phyogs 'jig rten 'jig gam snyam/ /pad+ma'i skye gnas skrag pas 'dar/ 27 khun tu bzang po'i mig 'phrul 'char ba'i me long lta'i/ /khang bzang lte bar nor gyi 'dab ldan 'dab dbus su/ /dbang sngon por gyi mkha' la gar gyi ri mo bzhin/ /kā la tsa kra khro chags nyams kyis rnam par 'gying / 28 /lha rnams rang gnas de der gar gyi rol pa yis/ /gcig pu du ma snang ba chu zla lta bu ste/ /mos pa'i rjes su rgyag phyir mtha' klas mu yang med/ /

༄7/ /zag med 'dod pa'i ro la longs su spyod par khums/wo /de yi g.yas dang g.yas min du/ /nye ba'i yid dang pad gta mtsho/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu'i phung po/ /chu bya'i 'phreng bas brten pa yod/30 shar sgor nor bu rin po che'i/ /khyams 'a mdzas par seng ge'i khrir/ /chos kyi sgo brgya gdangs pa'i nang / /skal pa bzang rnams myur du 'jugatso /bkod pa'i khyad par mchog de'i khyab bdag che/ /dpal ldan shwakya'i rigs kyi thig le las/ /srid zhi'i snang ba rab 'byams spro ba'i bzhi/ /chos kyi rgyal thabs wo po zla ba bzang /32 /lha dbang gzi brjid ༅ dang zla bas byin/ /lha yi dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs lha yi/ /dbang ldan zhes grags sprul pa'i rgyal po bdun/ /bde 'byung mdzas pa'i rgyan du byed pos bskos/33/dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis zhes/ /grags pa'i

sil snyan khrol de rtsa ba'i rgyad/ /'grel bshad stong phrag drug cus bkral ba gang / /'chad po bdun gyi mgal bum nyid las babs/ 34 /nyi ma'i rigs kyi nyi ma nub re'i stegs/ badzeg pa'o phyi lo nas bzung drug brgya'i mthar/ /smra ba'i zla ba 'jam dbyangs grags pa ste/ /bde 'byung shar gyi ri bo'i phrag par le'u/ 35 /tshangs pa'i drang srong phyed bcas bye ba bzhi/ /cod pan bcings pa'i rgyal po dgu bcu drug /sna tshogs rigs sde thams cad rdo rje yi/ /rigs gcig mdzad phyin rigs ldan zhes par bod/ 36 snya ba'i rgyud chen 'phreng 'dzin sdeb sbyor gyis/ /nyung ngur sdud ces ston pas lung bstan khur/ /nyi ma'i shing rtas drang po'i lam srang du/ /myur bar 'dren pa'i go cha mchog rab bsgos/ 37 /mi rtsub 'jam pa'i mgrin dbyangs rdzogs pa yab dang lha mo sgrol ma yum/ /sgoms 'jug dga' bzhi'i bde mtsho srub las

ra༅༅/ /snying rje'i rang gzugs bcom ldan 'das/ /nor bu pad+ma'i ge sar 'phreng ldan byams pa'i rdul mang 'dzag pa gang / /ma lus 'gro ba'i nyer mtshor smin de rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po 'o/ 38 /stong phrag bcu gnyis grangs rdzogs pa'i/ /rgyal 'grel dri ma med pa'i 'od/ /byed po 'di yi bgo skal zhes/ /shākya'i rgyal pos sngar lung bstan/ swo /brjod bya'i don gyi mdor bsdus tshoms/ /gnyis bcas bcu phrag gsum du bsdams/ /phyi nang gzhan gyi go rim bzhin/ /thar par 'dzig pa'i them skas btsugs/ 40 /don dam dbyings su bsnyen pa rgyud/ /phyi ma zhes bya pha rol med/ /chos kun zung 'jug ngo bo nyid/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas ris med pa/ 41 /yan lag rim pa drug gi sgo/ /mchog gi lam bzang rma med par/ /skal ba ldan rnams tshegs chung dus/ /bgrod byed rdo rje'i rnal 'byor

ro/ 42 /bdenadon nyi ma'i grangs kyi snod/ /de nyid bcu drug dga' ba'i ngos/ /gang bas kha spyor yan lag bdun/ /dar drag lang tsho'i dpal rab 'bar/ 43 /pad dkar sbubs su smin pa'i 'bras/ /rgyal sras bzang po'i mtshan 'dzin pa/ /rigs ldan rigs kyi nyi ma ni/ /gsum pa seng ge'i khri la bzhag 44 /de nas go la rgya skar gli /do shal ngom pa'i go rim bzhin/ /sprul pa'i rigs ldan che rnams kyis/ /bla med theg pa'i snang ba spros/ 45 /skabs der khyu mchog kha sgo las/ /sismyu'i klung bzhin rgyud rgyas 'grel/ /mthu ldan tsi lu paṇ+ḍi tas/ /'phags tshogs rgyu ba'i yul du drangs/ 46 /slad kyi 'jig rten mig gyur pa/ /nyer lngas bsil ba'o ljongs chen 'dir/ /skad gnyis bskyar ba'i zlos gar gyi/ /ltad mos thams cad tshim pa bsgrabs/ 47 /mtha' med nam mkha'i

༄༅༅/ /rjes song brtan gasku'i khams/ /kun khyab chos kyi dbyengs de 'jig rten gyi/ /dbang po lhan grub rang bzhin ye shes che/ /yin phyir phyogs rer gtam la 'chol mi rigs/ 48 /thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal rgya sde'i skyes pa rabs kyi 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dgazhi 'khri shing las/ rigs ldan pad+ma dkar po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste gnyis pa'o// //stong nyid shel gyi drwa bas bsdams pa'i lding khang nas/ /snying rje'i zla ba cha shas kun rdzogs phan bde'i dpal/ shes bya'i mkha' la ring du ba〈snad kyang gangs can byu/ /sa gzhi snang ba dkar pos 'gengs pa de ngo mtshar/ 1 /phyag na patho'i zhing 'di sngon/ /'khor ba bzhin du zab pa'i mtshor/ /las kyi bskan pa'i srog chags mang / /sngag bsngal nad kyis mnar bas gang / 2 /de la 'phags

mchog spyan ras kyis/ /gzigs pa'i rigs sngags yi ge drug /chos su gdams pa'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /ma 'ongs gdul byar byin gyis brlabs/ 3 /stoni pa rab zhir sim pa nas/ /'o rdzobargya 'das tshe 'phags mchog mthus/ /chu tshogs bri nas sā la'i nags/ /yid 'bab skyed mos tshal bzhin chags/ 4 /der ni spu sdug ri dwags khyu/ /bag yangs rgyu zhing gcan gzan bya/ /sna tshogs las kyi ri mo brgya/ r+sā/bris 'di kye ma su yis zlog 5 /gnod sbyin bdud dang srin po lha/ /rmu rgyal kho rje krog grog 'dre/ /ma sangs klu dang 'gong po bcus/ /sa gzhi khyon 'dir rang gir spyad/ 6 /'gro phan dus bab mtshan ma de dang de/ /ye shes spyan gyis gzigs nas snying rje'i gter/ /yal ga'i ri dwags zol gyis chu ba la/ /brag gi srin mo'i mdza' ba'i zhags pa phangs/ 7 /de gnyis bzhos pa'i mngal gyi nags 'dab

ra༅༅/ khas/ /rigs 'dra spre'u'i phra gu rnam drug 'thon/ /sa bon nyung yang 'bras ngu mang ba bzhin/ /brgya phrag bzhir 'phel phan tshun rtsod pa las/ /rus chen bzhir gyes bse rmu ldong dang stong ༄/ /rim gyis mi yi 'gro bar gnas gyur pa/ /gto dang 'bra yi dpal la longs spyod pas/ /gru 'dzin bdag po'i 'phrin las zhing du gyur/ 9 /de tsha yangs pa can gyi li tsa bī'i/ /rigs kyi thig le'i zla ba gsar pa zhig /lha3 bde 'byung gtsug tor la chags pa/ /gnya' ba seng khri'i steng du mngon dbang bskur/ 0 /de ni rgyal rabs nyi ma'i zer 'phreng rnams/ /'char ba'i pho nya dang po skya rengs bzhin/ /srid pa gnam du 'degs byed khri bdun pos/ /sa la legs pa'i dpal drug mgron du gnyer/ /de sogs rgyal po'i 'phreng rgyud nyi shu drug /'das tsha kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul lha/ /tho tho ri yi

gnyan btsan zhes grags pas/ /kun gsal mtha' yang rnam gnon rgyal po byang / 2/nam mkha'i mdzod las babs pa'i za ma tog /bsod nams dpal du thob pa snying po'i nor/ /gnyan po gsang ba ltar bod dam chos dbu/ /thog mar bzlos pa'i dge mtshan bgrang mtha' yas/9/da ste mi rabs lnga na 'di yi don/ /'chad shes blo gros ldan pa 'byung 'gyur zhes/ /rgyal po bde bar snyad pa'i rmi lam gli /me long nang du lha yis bstan pa mthong /rdzo /dus gsum bde gshegs snying rje'i snying po gzugs can bzhin du grin gyis grub/ /ma 'dris 'gro la mdza' zhing bshes pa'i snang ba dkar po rab tu 'byams/ /mthong thos dran nam reg pa yis kyang re ba las lhag 'bras byin pa'i/ /yad bzhin nor bu gzugs can bzung ba'i chos kyi rgyal po de zhabs dran/ 5/da ni gnam ri srong btsan zhes/ /grags pa'i mu khyud sar

ra༅༅/ /gshegs yab//bde sogs dpal gyi mdzas 'dzin pa/ /tsha spong bza' zhes mig yangs yum/ 6lhan cig 'dus pa'i 'o mtsho las/ /snying po bcud du 'dril ba'i mar/ /'khor ba'i gdung sel sman mchog tu/ /grub pa 'byung po kun la smin/ 7/bden don grangs las gcig dman pa'i/ /zhal gyi pad+ma 'dab rgyas spyan/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs bzhin du//legs pa'i mtshan dpes 'khyud de btsas/ skodze gyi sa 'dzin rab mtho'i rtse/ /thun mtshams gos dmar gyis klubasaltar/ /le brgan dar gyi thod bcings kyis/ /ltag zhal snying po'i nor bzhin sbas/ 9 /sa gzhi skyong ba thams cad rgizur phud ba'i pas snum byas pa'i//seng ge'i khri 'phang chen po la/ /lha dang bcas pa'i mngon dbang bskar/20/'jam mgon spral pa'i gar gyi mkhan po sardzo ṭas/ /brda' sprod rig pa'i

rol mo'i bsgyur bas gangs can pa'i/ /rna ba bdud rtsis yongs su gang las blo gros mthu/ /'phel phyir yi ge'i 'du byed gsar pa nye bar bskran/ lto /mtho ris yul 'khor rgyas byad dge ba bcu'i/ /khrims kyi gnya' shing lcid pas kun gnon tshe/ /dpal gyi dum bur rang byung bcu gcig zhal/ /ngal 'asna'i stegs bu 'god la byon nam snyam/ lto /phun tshogs snang ba'i gter sgo ne pā la'i/ /dbang po'i bu mo khri btsun zla bzhin ma/ /'phrin las grogs su chas pa'i skyes nor du/ /mi bskyod rdo rje cod yul mchod byar khyongs/ sa /'dod dgu'i dbyed 'jo stong khun rgyal po che'i/ /lha cig ong jo ri dwags mig can mas/ khukya mu ne dad pa'i shing rta la/ /bcibs de gangs can bsod nams mgroni du bos/ 24 /bden dang bral ba sha rjen za ba mo/ /'jigs rung sa la nyal 'dra'i snying ga der/ /gtsug lag khang ming

༄༅༅/ /'dzugs pa'i nyer bsdogs su/ /me btsa'i dpyad kyis yan lag rnam par mnan/ 25 /srin mo'i snying khrag 'o mtshor gnas 'gyur pa'i/ /dbus su gor ma brtsegs pa'i lding khang na/ /ra sa 'phral gyi mchod sdong snang ba'i sgo/ /phye bar dge legs thams cad 'jug pa bsgrubs/ 26 /phal blo'i spyod pas ma reg zag med rdzi /bde chen longs la spyod pa'i rnarmo 'phral gar/ /srid pa'i ra bar rtsen pa'i ltad mo la/ /da dung blta bar bzod pa'i mig de dge/ 27 /rgya bal cod kyi mkhas pas dam pa'i chos/ /bsgrur bshad gtan zlo phab pa'i 'od po ches/ /mun par byed pa'i rtsa lag tshar bcad nas/ /dag pa'i snang ba dkar pos rjes su bzung / 28 /sgrib byed ma dmigs ye shes gsal ba'i spyan/ /mkha' ltar yangs pas ma gzigs chos de gang / /'byung 'gyur lung du bstan nas yab yum

gsum/ /rang byon thugs rka' dpal gyi be'ur thim/ 29 /rigs kyi dal 'gro'i rgyun bzang ma chad pas/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin zhing sa brlan pa las/ /phan bde'i myu gu ma tshang med pa ni/ /dus kyi mthar yang nyams par ga la 'gyur/ 30 /kun tu rmongs pa'i 'khri shing rgyas pa'i grib ma mi zad pa/ /mun par 'bab pa gcod byed nor bu'i zer rnon mtshon cha can/ /po ṭa la yi khyab bdag gang zhig chos kyi rgyal po'i skur/ /nyi ma bzhin du shar bas sa 'di skal bzang snang bas khyab/ sti /thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa rabs kyi 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dga'i 'khri shing las/ chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste gsum pa'o// //yod med phyogs 'jigs shing rta'i srol byed klasab zhi /dgongs don 'grel la gzhan dring mi 'jog

༄༄/ /rang rgyud du/ /smra ba'i khyu mchog sdom ga' bo dhi sa twa zhes/ /nyer zhi'i 'tsho bas blo gros lus rdzogs de bsngags 'os/ 1 /skyid pa'i nyi ma shar phyogs 'phags pa'i yul/ /za hor rgyal khams pad+ma'i nags kyi ljongs/ /rab rgyas sa yi bdag po'i pho brang ni/ /bsgri la ste skabs gsum grong khyer 'dra/ 2 /sgra zer khu bas rab byugs rkarje ta'i/ /mda' yab chu 'dzin bu mos 'byud pa la/ /sngo bsangs nam mkha'i mdzes ma phrag dog mes/ /rngul ba'i thigs 'phreng mu tig char du babs/ 3 /gser gyi ba gam brtsegs pa'i khang bzang sgor/ /sna tshogs nor bu'i rta babs lta na sdug /'od phung 'bar bas lha yi 'jig rten sgo /khengs pa'i mun pa 'phrog la rings pa bzhin/ 4 /rin chen ra ba'i khor yug grong khyer ches/ /bskor bas mdzes pa'i dpal gyis ma ngoms par/ /skyed tshal khrus kyi rdzing

bur rtse 'dod pa'i/ /'khri shing na chung glu len gar gyis rtsen/ 5 /dpal gyi 'gror pa rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i 'jing / /dgos 'dod yid bzhin rab 'jo nor bus gtapas/ snya gsum longs spyodi la yang 'bu ba yi/ /gser gyi rgyal mtshan mngon mtho'i rgyal khab yod/ snyo /de yi bya 'dab 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /kha sapo ṇi'i mdun sa dag pa'i zhing / /gru 'dzin gnyis pa gang der sa skyong ba'i/ /rgyal po grags pa zla ba lta bur dkar/ 7 /rigs kyi thig le ma nyams sras kyi gtso/ /sgyu rtsal gnas la byang ba'i dge mtshan 'bum/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lor 'grems pas mi bsnyengs pa/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi lhan skyes rang bzhin yin/ 8 /ye shes snying po yongs smin paṇ+ḍi ta/ /thams cad yod smra'i mkhan po brtan mkhas rdzi /yon to 'bras bus dud pa dpag bsam sgo /rkang 'thung de las 'dod pa'i dngos

ra༅༅/ /po grub/ 9 /rnam da1da ldan pas shes bya rig pa'i gnas/ /rnam lnga ma 'dres thugs kyi zla shel la/ /gsal ler sha min gli /ri mo so sor 'byed pa'i spobs pa thob/ 10 /rtag chad chang gis myos pa'i rang nyams kyis/ /thub pa'i bstan la sdang ldan mu stegs stsezhags ring yang smra ba yi/ /seṅge 'dis ma bcoms pa gang zhig mchis/ 11 /skabs der bsil ba'i ljongs chen 'dir/ /thub bstan me tog rnama'agrungs kyang 'dab ma'i rgya/ /ma grol mtshan dus mun pas bsdams/ 12 /dbyig gi khu bas mun pa'i khams/ /bkru ba'i cho ga rdzogs phyir sngergya'i yul du/ /dam chos bsu ba'i pho nyar mngags/ d+ku /mngon par shes pa'i snang ba la/ /nye bar spyod pa'i hwa shang mchid/ /byang 'phags spre

'di lta 'ong zhes 'dra 'bag bstan/ 14 /gdong dmar can du dkar po'i chos/ /dar bar byed po khyod dang gzhan/ /zhi 'tsho mkhas pa'i dbang po nyid/ /stobs bcu pa yis sngar lung bstan/ 15 /de phyir 'bad pa'i gru gzings la/ /rab zhen ded dpon snying stobs kyis/ ān+ta rak+ṣi ta zhes bya'i/ rin chen rin thang can delong / 16 /zhes serdzogs de la de gdams tshe/ /de de bzhin ces sems rangs pas/ /rang yul serdzon tshe yab rgyal po/ /khri lde gtsug brtan mtho ris snyegs/ 7 /de sras khri srong lde'u btsan/ /blo gros pon kyang lus gzhon par/ /brnyas bcas sdig blon sta re yis/ /chos khrims tsū ta'i rtsa ba bcad/ 18 /'od brgyas 'byud pa'i gser gyi snying po thub chen tshodze mu ne yang / /bsod nams bzhin du lcid pas ma g.yos gter bzhin sa 'og snying por sba/ /sngal pa'i pho brang lha sa lha

si༅༅/ /yi bsti gnas dam pa gshin rje yi/ /grong khyer ji bzhin skyi g.ya' 'di ko kye ma lus med sgyu mas bskrun/ 19 /de dus bslu med las kyi gnam lcags lce/ /lhung bas de de'i legs spyad bzhin du rgyab/ /gas shing lus skam cho nge'i sgra mthon po/ /'jigs rung gzhin rje spron pa'i rol mo bzhin/ 20 /thub gzugs bye mas mnan pa'i le lan ces/ /kun rtog mdzub rtses bris pa'i ri mo la/ /'chel bas thub pa shugs 'gro'i shing rta'i rtser/ /bkod de mang yul skyid pa'i grong du drangs/ lto /'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i gar gyi rnam 'gyur mkhan/ /khri srong lde'u btsan sngon goms bag chags rdzi /dbang bsgyur chos kyi gtam la dgyes pa na / /bstan pa'i sgron ma 'bar ba'i blo gros skyes/ 22 /bzang po'i bag chags gsal snang shar ba des/ /zhi ba'i 'tsho las rab byung sems bskyed kyi/ /bstul

gugs nyer thob ye shes dbang po'i mtshan/ /don dang mthun pa'i bya ba bsgrub la 'grus/ r+sā /mkhan po'i ljags kyi 'gyur las 'di skad ces/ /khyod dang nga dang bod kyi btsan po gsum/ /bde gshegs 'od srung bstan la bya rdzi ma'i/ /bur skyes bod du thub bstan spel bar smon/ 24 /de lta na'ang khyod gnyis lus myu gu/ /phra phyir 'bras bu btu ba'i dus nyid du/ /ma bab bod kyi rgyal rabs dgu'i bar du/ /sgug sdod ngal ba nga yis bsten no gsungs/ 25 /skabs der chos kyi dbyings las blo gros rdzi /nor ldan snying rjes khros nas bstan pa'i dgra/ /gsoni por dong du gcur yang ma tshim kha/ /sra brtan pha wang lcid pas rnam par mnan/ 26 /de nas chos smra'i mkhan po bod yul du/ /zhabs kyi pad+mo rnam par 'du 'god tshe/ /ka shi sha'i rdos nor gyi bu la bzhin/ /bzang ngan brtags mthar yid ches khri la bkod/ 27 /

ra༅༅/ /dge bcu rten 'brel bcu gnyis khams bco brgyad/ /chos kyi rol mor bsgrags pas nag po'i sde/ /khros 'grug rngams pa'i rba rlabs cher grubs pa'i/ /cho 'phrul chu srin rgyal mtshan bsgreng des sbyar/ 28 /phan bde'i rtsa lag 'dzugs dus mi srun rlung / /slo bur ldang mod skyo bar ci ste rigs/ /nye kun zhi byed 'od kyi shing rta'i sngon/ /nyes bskyed nam mkha'i ta ma la dang mtshungs/ 29 /ma chags pad+ma bzhad pa'i za 'u 'bur/ /rang byung rigs sngags 'chang ba yongs kyi rje/ /pad+ma sam+bha zhes grags mthu stobs kyis/ /srid gsum g.yo bar nus de spyan drongs zhes/ 30 /ji ltar gdarmis bzhin g.yar 'dren bya ma rta'i/ /bkod pa lha mig dag pas gsal gzigs nas/ /bod yul lha srin gtsigs la 'bebs bzhin du/ /ngam shod lo lha ta yi ngogs su gshegs/ tso /slad kyi lha mi'i mchod gnas

shākya'i tog /bkod pa'i khyad par mtshar pos mdun bltas te/ /ra sa 'phrul gyi snang ba rab 'byams pa/ /bod yul rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par gsol/ 32 /bsam yas yoni tan dpal du rab 'bar bas/ /mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gardo la/ /bsedi nams rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas dam pa/ /sā la dge legs bzhin du 'god pa'i sngon/ 33 /nor 'dzin dpal gyi lha mo brtan ma las/ /sa yi bgo skal len pa'i cho ga gang / /pad+ma drag por bzhengs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i gar la rnam par zhugs/ 34 /rta gdong me lce drag por langs 'dra khro chen 'bar ba'i gar thabs can/ /gtum pa'i nga ro hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sgras sa gsum g.yo ba'i 'byul 'khor gyis/ /bdud bgegs skag pa'i mig rtsa 'dar byas tsit+ta lkog mar 'tshangs bzhin du/ /nam mkha'i pha rol las kyang brgal te ring du 'bros pa'i go skabs

ra༅༅/ /sbyin/35/bgegs bral bkra shis dpal thams cad/ /sa la bsakod pa'i khyad par bskrun/36 /'phags yul o tan+d+ra snya sa'i/ /dpe zlar chas pa'i gtsugabacas/37 /mi mjad 'jig rten gzhan pa zhig /'di ya me long du shar ram/ /'on te sbrikhams gsum zangs kyi khang pa bzang / /bu tshal gser gyi ba gam mtho/ /dge rgyas li ma'i tsā bsalus brtas paṇ+ḍi ta/ /bodhi satwar grags dang pad+ma yi/ /'byung gnas tshur mthong byis ga'

'bum phrag 'khrigs pa'i sprin sngoni las/ /bkra shis dpal gyi gru char bla na med/ /bkra shis 'brug sgra'i glu dbyangs len bzhin du/ /bkra shis rab tu gnas pa'i rgya mtshor phab/ 41 /rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs gangs can du/ /dar zhing rgyas pa'i dga' ston chen po la/ /lo grangs bcu gnyis dgyes dgur spyod pa 'di/ /dkur phyogs gzengs su bstod pa'i brda thabs mtshon/ 42 /'on te bod yul rmongs pa'i mi 'di dag /legs gsung 'dul ba'i snod du rung ngam zhes/ /sad phyir yod smra'i dge 'dun mthun dbus su/ /mi bdun bsnyen rdzogs ngur smig rtags kyis spud/ 43 /bo dhi satwa'i mkhan bu thub grangs zhi /ljon pa la brten ska cog zhang la sogs/ /lo tsā'i 'khri shing me tog 'bras bu can/ /stong rtsa brgyad kyis dge legs bcud du spel/ 44 /chos kyi grwa sde chen po bcu gnyis su/ /'khor lo

ra༅༅/ /gsum gyi bya bas dus 'da' ba'i/ kheng rta'i srol chen 'di 'dra rgya gar na'ang / /rnyed pa dka' zhes skyes bu che 'ga' gleng / 45 /bi ma smu dang shān+ti gar+bha serdzogs/ /mkhas pa'i grub brnyes zla ba'i lding khang gi/ /grib ma sa la 'phos pas bho ṭa'i yul/ /skal pa bzang po'i go 'phang dag la bkod/ 46 /de nas ye shes gsal ba'i spyan zur gyis/ /phyi ma'i mtha' la gzigs pa dri med du/ shar ba'i lung bstan brdzun pa spangs pa'i 'phrin/ /bo dhi satwa'i zhal las 'di ltar brgyus/ 47 /pad+ma'i snying por rang byung sprul pa'i ska'i/ /bka' rtags spyi bor bcings pa'i ḍa ki ni/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis sung bod yul 'dir/ /mthu ldan mu stegs byed kyis mi gtser yang / 48 /lta grub smri mthun rtsod pa sta re yis/ /bstan pa'i zhin shing dum bur byed 'gyur te/ /pad+ma'i ngang tshul

bzang pos chos phyogs su/ /zhi byed cho ga sgrub phyir spyan drongs zhes/ 49 /legs par gdams pa'i bdud rtsi'i bcud bda' ba/ /gsor gyi dkyil 'khor 'dus la bstabs nas de/ /las kyi myong bya bzhin du mgyogs 'gro'i phras/ /bskul nas nyer zhi'i dbyengs su da gzod zhugs/ 50 /yang dag smon pa'i 'bras bu la sred dam pa'i spyod tshul kha na ma tho med/ /'byung po yongs la thugs brtse'i spyan ras sgoms par gzigs nas mtha' 'khob mun pa'i gling / /chos kyi snang ba chen po'i rlabs kyis kun tu khyab las dge legs gos darkan po/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dag la rngam brjid bgyid 'di zhi ba 'tsho yi drin/ spyo /thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa rabs kyi 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dga'i 'khri shing las/ ā tsārla bo dhi sa ta'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bzhi

ra༅༅/ /pa'o// //lung rigs sder 'phreng drag por bsnun pas phyir rgol glang po'i myos 'bum 'jig /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i gad brgyangs bsgrags pas lta ngan ri dwags snying rtsa 'dar/ /mchog gi dngos po yongs su grub pas mkha' spyod dag pa'i nags tshal skyong / /smra ba'i seṅge nā ro pa zhes snyan grags srid pa'i mthar yang ring / 1 /dgra bcom nyi ma gung pa zhes/ /nyon mongs sbubs las rnam grol bas/ /ston pa'i lung bstan mkhan po'i gsung / /gtsug rgyan bzhin du bkur ba des/ 2 /kha cher lung pa dgu'i 'dus mdo/ /rgya chen skyil krung gcig gis mnan/ /gdengs can 'khrags pa'i cho 'phrul rnams/ /mchod pa'i sprin du rang gir mdzad/ 3 /klu las blangs pa'i nor 'dzin gdong / /gur gum byugs pa'i mdangs kyis mdzes/ /smya mas yul 'khor /smi ra/ /'jigs med byin

rlabs thub bstan snod/ 4 /de ste 'chi med grong gi dgazha ba'i tshal/ /ma nyams sa la bkrams pa'i grong khyer ni/ /dpe med legs pa'i dpe der tshangs pa'i regs/ /rgyal por dbang thob dge ba'i go cha dang / 5 /dpal gyi blo gros rab yangs bzhin bzang mas/ /dgazha ba'i dga' stoni chu gter bsrubs pa la/ /kun tu bzang po'i nyi ma gzir 'bar ba/ /srid pa'i lha lam 'di la dal gyis shar/ tu /rang rigs la 'os las drug sgyu rtsal gyi/ /pha rol phyin kyang ma tshim bye smra ba'i/ /mkhan po dzi na mi tra'i zhal skyin las/ /rab byung chos kyi dzol mtshan mthon por bsgrengs/ 7 /rig gnas gru chen mthun pa'i rlung sbyar nas/ /sde snod rgya mtshor brgal der rgyad sde'i nor/ /snying stobs tog tu 'degs bzod ded dpon ming / /gnas brtan bstan pa 'dzin pa'i mchog tu btags/ 8 /mi brjed gzungs kyis tshig don

go༅༅/ /kun bzung nas/ /rang gzhan grub pa'i mtha' la kha lo bsgyur/ /mu stegs rgol ba stong gi g.yul ngo la/ tajigs med grags pa'i go 'phang 'di yis thob/ 9 /ji snyed shes bya'i chos rnams nyid thugs la/ /smin pa'i zhabs zung 'khor lo'i re khā can/ /rgyun gter khri la bzhag nas rgyal bstan srog /gzung ba'i snyan grags bzang pos khor yug brgal/ 10 /thos bsam gnyis su 'thung ba'i dbang po sgom pa'i rdzing bur 'jug 'dod pa/ /kun rtog nyer zhi'i ka bar btanas kyang mi gnas be'u'i rna ba bzhin/ /'di ste yongs su gdul ba'i man ngag gang zhig grogs su thob gyur snyam/ /sems pas rgyud kyi glegs bam dag la spyan ras gan gyis gzigs pa lcang / 11 /de tshe grib ma'i mig sman char/ /sa la glo bur babs gzigs pas/ /mi sngag mtshan mas lus mtshan pa'i/ /'jigs rung

gyad med 'di skad lo/ 12 /chos de'i tshig gi de don shes/ /smra la tshig shes brjod tshe dga'/ /don shes smra la mi dga' ba'i/ /gnad de spros zhes slar dris tshe/ 9 /khyod mkhas tshig shes smra ba bden/ /cig sgordzos rdzun pa'i ngag tu zad/ /de phyir dgazha dang mi dgazha ba'i/ /rnam 'gyur 'di ni kho mos bstan/ yon /zhes smra 'o na 'di don ni/ /ji bzhin shes pa yod dam ci/ /brjod la nga yi ming po ni/ /tismis shes zer mi snang gyur/ 15 /de ngag yang dag yang dag min/ /brtag phyir yi ge bdun pa'i sngags/ /'bum phrag bsnyen mthar nam mkha'i sgras/ /tikhris rjes su 'dzin zhes gdams/ 16 /blo ldan dad pa'i gzhan dbang can/ /bla ma 'tshol la ci ste zhum/ /sbrang rtsi 'thung rnams pad tshal gyi/ /phyogs su 'bad pas rgyag min nam/ 17 /mkhas pa'i spyi bos ku sā li'i/ /rkang stegs brten par mi 'os

go༅༅/ /zhes/ khoskol 'debs brag cha'i glu dbyangs la/ /blun po min pa su zhig sred/ khar phyogs rgyal khams nam mkha' bzhin du rgya che bar/ /rlung gis drangs pa'i go la bzhin du 'byams pa'i mthar/ /bzhul gyis dub pa'i don mthun bzhin du ngal 'tsho'i slad/ /tshangs pa'i drang srong dgyes pa bzhin du nags 'dab bston/ 9 /der ni rma bya'i sgro yi stod g.yog can/ /ri dwags mthar byed kyis mthong sa bdag la/ /gtapa snyan bzhin du bsnyad pas paṇ+ḍi ta/ /brgya phrag lnga pa'i gtsug tor stegs la bkod/20/gsang chen pho nya'i lam gyi mdza' na mo/ /phyag rgyas bakha pa'i gtam gsar gcig nas gcig /brgyud pa mi bdag rna ba'i bu ga ru/ /zhugs pa'i rnam 'gyur thugs su ga la sim/lto /mi snyan tshig mda' bsnan la cher khros pa'i/ /kha nas 'bar ba'i lce zhags ring brkyangs mthus/ /

rus med lus kyi bud shing sreg bzhed pas/ /drag po'i ting 'dzin bsgrub la de thugs spro/ lto /de mthus rgyal po dpung bcas brlag 'gyur snyam/ /'jigs nas sa dang ri yang 'dar mthong ba'i/ /zhing skyong mkha' 'gros ma bzod sgya thabs kyis/ /bzlog nas slar yang til brdung tshol la chas/ lto /'dod pa'i rin chen gling du bgrod la gegs/ /da/'a phran bcu gnyis 'dzin khris mdun bkargo kyang / /snying stobs g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung dkar pos/ /phug pa'i khrag rgyun dga' ba'i dar du phyar/ 24 /de nas phun tshogs 'byung khungs bhaṅga la'i/ /o tsa ya na gtsug gi nor bu zhes/ /grags pa'i ba dan 'bum phrag 'phyang ba yi/ /gtsug lag khang pa chen po'i ngogs su gshegs/ 25 /'dod pa'i 'bras 'byin yongs 'du lha yi shing / /mthong ba'i dang por bsung zhim 'thul ba ltar/ /snga nas grags pa'i dbyangs kyis

ra༅༅/ /mtshams sbyar des/ /dge la 'dun pa'i tshogs kyi sri zhus mchod/ 26 /'di na rnal 'gror dbang phyug til+li pa/ /zhes bya'i grub thob bzhugs sam khyed kyis smros/ /de dris lan du rnal 'gror dbang phyug ni/ /ma mthong de ming can gyi sprang po'am ci/ 27 /zhes smra'i skabs der nam mkha'i gos can mi sdug mdog 'dzin rnal 'gror pas/ /nya gson sregs la lū hi dza zhes slar yang 'tsho ba'i cho 'phrul gyis/ /til brdung chen por nges pa rnyed des rjes su 'dzin par gsol btab tshe/ /ba gam brtsegs ma lhun po ltar mtho'i rgya phubs khri la yud kyis 'dzegs/ 28 /der rjes 'brangs la de yis ni/ /'di nas mchong bar nus pa su/ /zhes gsungs grogs gzhan ma dmigs snyam/ /mkha' las rdo lcang bzhin du mchongs/ 29 /lus kyi phyi nang 'dam bu'i tshal/ /thub tshod glang chen snoni pas brdzis/ /

rus pa'i mtshon chas don dang snod/ /phye ma bzhin du phye mar brlag 30 /'on te 'grodazhabs dran pa'i/ /dasha' ba che 'di dang por spyad/ 7 /phyag gis de yi lus byugs tesngar bzhin langs/ 32 /de sogs dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal la 'gran pa'i/ /dpokha ཿhro kyis myos glang chen 'jug ltar spro/ 33 /bcu gnyis lo 'das nangs kyi mtha' mapo'i nor/ /len phyir dbang po'i phral ldan maṇ+ḍal phul/ 34 /khrag rgyan rngul gsar spre

༄༅༅/ /'phangs des 'khor ba'i rang mtshang kun brtol nas/ /ye shes rang zhal gzigs pa'i dngos po grub/ 35 /spang rtogs yon tan 'chi med bcud dam pas/ shes rab bum pa bzang po yongs gang ba/ /nā ro'i rnam dpyod snod du byo 'di yis/ /kun sbyor dri ma ming tsam lhag mar byas/ 36 /mgar ba'i spong du rkyen 'gas zhe sdang gi/ /rtog pa'i myu gu rang bzhin med gzigs pas/ /'khor ba'i sdong po sgyu ma'i gar stabs su/ /rig pa bla ma'i drin las gzhan du tse/ 37 /snyam nas rin chen bye ru'i me tog 'phreng / /phul tshe bye ru'i de'ur zhabs bkod pa'i/ /rdzu 'phral dngos por zhen dang khengs rgyas pa'i/ /kun rtog can la mthing slad nyid du bstan/ 38 /bshad dam sgom zhes rmed la bde skyong snod/ /rnam snang bcud kyis gang pa'i brda thabs kyis/ /nyams su long zhes gdam par go la

des/ /de de bzhin sna rigs kyi bu zhes gsungs/ swo /ge sar 'phreng mdzes ga bur yongs 'thul nyams su bde ba'i ljongs/ /sna tshogs me tog 'dab ma rab yangs dbyed kyi dpal rgyas pa'i/ /zhing du rkang drug pa rnams glu len gar gyi rnam par rol pa can/ /ri 'o gser gyi gling du grags par drang por srong 'di dges bzhin bsti/ 40 /de nas rmongs sde rnam gnon gtsug lag khang / /mkhas mang 'du ba'i gling du rgol 'dod kyi/ /glang chen rig pa'i chang gis myos pa rnams/ /thub gzhung pad rdzing 'dam du rdzi bar lhags/ 41 /de dag blo gros lus stobs rnam par rgyas/ /mthong nas skragapas snying rtsa g.yo ba phal/ /rang rang bstan pa rgyal ba'i ru mtshon du/ /bzhag nas rtsod ngag 'phen la spro ba nyams/ 42 /da dung khyod cag bgros la gcer bu par/ /smra ba spobs pa'i khyu mchog yode na kwa'i/ /dpa' mtshan

༄༄/ /me tog 'phreng ba 'di longs shig /med na dbang thang de yi dbang du 'gyur/43/zhes pa rgyal tsho tshig gis slar rmed pas/ /blo chen blo rnams skrag pas zhon de'i tsha/ /dgrangs can mgrin par bzung ba'i nā ro pa/ /kho mo'i khyim na bzhugs zhes rgan mos glengs/44 /de la rab dga' ba spu'i bla gos phrug/rgyan pa'i paṇa chen rnams kyis gsol btab lan/ /smra ba bdag 'dra gnas sar mu stegs byed/ khong bar nus pa tsam yang ches mi rigs/45/de bas smra ba'i seng ge dngos stobs kyis/ /rigs tshul gad brgyangs sgrogs la dpa' ba ngas/ /nam mkha'i gos kyis bkab pa'i lag ldan sde/ /mche ba'i bar du 'jug la dasha' ba ci/46 /de skad bsgrags pa tsam gyis phas rgol snying / /lkog mar lud pas rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'du ba'i spobs pa ma lus phyogs de'i tsha/ /de

yis lha khang mdun du bkod pa bshams/ 47 /rgole dang phyir rgol dpang po dang bcas pa/ /so so'i khri la 'dzegs nas gleng bslangs tshe/ /bsgom zhes rjes gdams bla ma'i gsung 'gongs par/ /yid kyis nyes chags skad cig de'i mode la/ 48 /dur khrod rgyan chas sgeg pa'i gar/ /nam mkhar bsgrur ba'i til+li pa/ /kha ṭaṃ bsdegs nas bsad pa'i maso/ /rlon pa dpa' ba'i mtshan mar ngom/ 49 /stag sham rab grol sder mo'i 'phreng / /smra ngan srog la 'jigs ster bzhin/ /mkha' rmi char sprin ltar gshegs la/ /nā ros gus pa'i phyag byas tshe/ 50 /snying rjes dbul ba srin po'i gzugs/ /'di la bkur sti sgrub byed pa/ /de ni shākya'i bstan pa las/ /phyir phyogs des na pham zhes zer/ 51 /paṃ paṃ sngags kyi nga ror bcas/ /rdo rje ltar gtum sdigs mdzub rtse/ /bstan pa'i mod la mu stegs pa'i/ /lugs

ra༅༅/ /ngan bzhin du khang pa'ang zhig 52 /rdzu 'phrul rgyud las nyer drangs pa'i/ /lung rigs mda' snan bsnun ma thag /rtag chad grub pa'i mtha' thams cad/ khaṃ gyur phyis ldang ga la srid/ 53 /phyogs dang gling las rnam rgyal ba'i/ khyod pa'i khyu mchog chen po des/ /rnam gzhon ngang tshul chos kyi grwa'i/ /byang sgo skyong ba'i sgo glegs thob/ 54 /gur gum ljongs kyi dpal 'phos pas/ /mkha' yang li khri'i snang ba 'dzin/ /de yis me tog mdangs phyogs pa'i/ /bste gnas sa yi bdag pos phul/ 55 /lta stangs bzhi dang grub brgyad rgi /spobs pa'i zil gyis kun mnan pas/ /legs byas 'joms pa'i chom rkun tshogs/ /yang dag lta ba'i khang bur bcings/ 56 /bskyol zhugs spyod pa'i mkha' lding gi/ 'ang rta rab zhon nā ro pas/ /kun khyab mchog gi go 'phang la/ /'jug pa'i skal bzang yud

kyis brnyes/ 57 /slob ma'i mchog brgyad paṇa chen bkra shis grangs kyis 'byud/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa lnga bcu brgyad sogs mu mtha' yas/ /khyad par nyid kyi lcam gcig grub brnyes nirgyaltas/ /rgyal bstan spel ba'i dpe zlar rgya la ba rang nyid 'os/ 58 /chos kyi blo gros rab rgyas 'jig rten mig /'od du 'bar ba kun tu bzang po'i 'phrul/ /byang phyogs mun pa'i 'khri shing mthar byed du/ /lung bstan sras kyi mthu bor bsngags de rgyal/ 59 /thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa rabs kyi 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dgazhi 'khri shing las/ mkhas dbang grub pa'i dpa' bo me ma mur pa chen po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste lnga pa'o// //rgyal kun snying rje'i thig ler 'khrungs pa sems dpa' me tog zla ltar mdzes/ /don kun 'dab rdzogs pad+ma'i bla ma srid dang zhi ba'i

ra༅༅/ /dpal du rgyas/ /dngos kun gsal mdzad zla 'od gzhon nu thub bstan rgya mtsho 'phyar ba'i dbyed/ /chos kun gzigs pa dri med sman gyis 'gro rnams 'tsho byed de'i zhabs mchod/ 1 /byang phyogs rgyud du dge slong 'tsho byed ces/ /snying po'i bstan zlo bya ba rgya chen po/ /sgrub mkhas grub pa'i srol 'byed 'byung 'gyur zhes/ /stobs bcu pa yi lung bstan dus la bab/ 2 /dge bcu'i chos lung dkar po gnyal gyi ljongs/ /phan bde dpal gyi rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /skyid pa'i rba rlabs ring po mkhar 'khyud pas/ /rab dkar dbu ba'i do shal ngom pa der/ 3 /rigs rus rab gtsang gaṅgā'i rgyun ma rmad/ /rnyi ba rgyal po'i mkha' las babs pa de/ /phul byung cho 'brang dal ba'i mngal gyi mtsho/ /phun tshogs nor bu 'gyung ba'i khungs su 'khyil/ 4 /rgya bal bod kyi sman pa tshe'i rig byed/ /tshangs pa

lta bur dran 'dra sum cu'i bcud/ /mkhyen rab dbyangs can grogos pos 'thungs pas zhang / /yan lag brgyad smra'i khyu mchog dar ma grags/ 5 /goso dkar 'dzin pa khyim pa'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /'gro ba'i nad gso sman gyi cho ga la/ /brtson 'di sngon gyi 'tsho byed gzhon nus gsos/ /slar yang byon nam nad pa'i srog rab brtan/ 6 /skabs der btsun mo sras bcas dus kyi khar/ /song bas 'khor ba'i ngang tshul 'di lta zhes/ /skyo shas lcags kyu lci ba'i dbang gyur pa'i/ /sems kyi glang po dam chos rdzing bur zhugs/ 7 /blo ldan shes rab ces bya mang yul ba/ /mkhan por bsnyen nas ngur sgrig rtags bzung des/ /'dul ba 'bum sder sbyangs mthar dpal bde mchog /zangs dkar lugs kyi tshig don thugs mtshor gtams/ 8 /dī paṃ ka ra'i rjes slob rgyal ba'i bathakha/ /gdams ngag snying por 'debs

go༅༅/ /mkhas dge ba'i bshes/ /mang po'i zhal las rgyu ba'i chos tshul kun/ /rnam dgrod za ma tog gi bcud du lon/ 9 /ting 'dzin thun re'i zhags pas nyin zhag bdun/ /g.yo med 'ching bar nus pa'i mthu ldan 'dis/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim yud tsam la/ /bgrod par mi dasha' legs byas stobs las grub/ 10 /dkar brgyud bstan pa'i ba dan 'degs nus 'di'o zhes/ /rab dgyes bzhad pa'i tshoms 'od rdo rje 'grems bzhin du/ /slong mos 'tsho ba'i snang brnyan sprul pa'i smon mchid kyis/ /dbus pa ston pa'i 'dun stobs mi la'i phyogs su bsgyur/ 11 /bden med rmi lam dwangs pa'i mtshor/ /bden nges dge ba'i gzugs brnyan bkra/ /'di ste ma 'ongs bstan 'gro'i don/ /rlabs chen grub pa'i rten 'byung lags/ 12 /grogs bcas dada' ba'i khur chen po/ /phrag pa'i ka bas

brten bzhin du/ /spro bas rab bde bkrashis sgang / khog min gzhan pa der son to/ rka /bsod nams rin chen mas dge ba/ /rna ba'i snod du sus blugs pa'i/ /smo gnyis lhun gyis grub bo zhes/ /ched du bsngags pa'i me tog gtor/ rdzo /mas nyid rab rdzogs pad+ma'i snod/ /byin rlabs ༄da kyis yongs gang ba/ /dngos grub bzhin du longs spyod kyi/ /'khor lor sim pa'i badzi' babs thob/ 15 /dpal ldan sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang bzhi'i dga' ston cher myong bas/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs las dbugs phyung nas/ /thar pa mchog tu gzengs kyang bstod/ 16 /rdo rje bas mo'i byin chen pos/ /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du brlabs/ /bsre ba gsum gyi nye lam las/ /rdo rje'i sa chen sgeg pas rings/ 7 /yongs sbyangs dbang po'i zhing ga'an par/ /rim gnyis sa bon bskran ma thag /brnag dasha'i

si༅༅/ /drod rtags snyema'i khur/ /'bras bu bzang po yud kyis smin/ 18 /de nas gdams dang rjes gdams a mṛ tas/ /blo gros lang tsho rgyas de phyer ldog tshe/ /da ste bcu gnyis lo la rtogs pa'i phul/ /thun mong min pa mngon du 'gyur zhes gsungs/ 19 /byed cing mtshon cha gtum pos 'phongs tshos la mi srol dra bar sbrel ba de bstan nas/ /ches zab gdams ngag snying po 'di yin zhes/ /rlung gi 'bral 'khor mkhan la sun 'byin bsgrubs/ 20 /phyags lham sgar mo'i rtsa ba la bston pa'i/ /ha zlum sdong po chos gos rnam gsum gyi/ /yal 'dab rab rgyas r+sha ser me tog bcas/ /bka' gdams ldam bu'i tshal du t+na zhig chags/ lto /yul gyi dga' ba'i rjes 'brangs bag chags rdzi /ri mo 'khor ba'i gzugs su 'bri mkhas kyang / /lce mchu brel tsam snying por 'dzin pa yi/ /g.yeng

re bu phrogs/ lto /de tshe sgom gyi skal bas dben to snyam/ /zhum pa'i thugs ni mi la'i gsung gis gsal/ /ltos pa'i khur chen lcid pa der bkar sko de nyid gzigs pa'i go 'phang brnyes/ sa /gnyis med gsung ba rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ /gal te nga lung bstan na 'di las 'di/ /skye bar pa'i chus bran pas/ phreng las 'phreng ba skam po'i myu gu 'brungs/ 24 /gto tshigs yang dag de mthong chab rgyun gyis/ /khong khre'i me phung bcom /snang ba rab tu 'byams pa'i dga' stoni la/ /gnyug mar gnas rnams longs su spyod la dbang / 25 /'ol dgazha dga' ba'i tshal du lo bdun ba sgrab pa'i rgyal mtshan 'bum bsgrengs pa'i/ /snyan grags grags pa'i dbyar skyes rnga chen sgras/ /phyogs kun kun nas khyab pa'i dpal yon

ra༅༅/ /thob/ 26 /de nas stsor gyi lang tsho cher bdo ba'i/ /nor 'dzin bu mo sngo ljang gos gyon pa/ /chags pa'i drod kyis rngul thigs 'dzag pa'i dus/ /'o de gung rgyal gangs kyi reg pa bsten/ 27 /mthing 'od ta ma la yi lding khang tshar du dngar ba'i chu ris can/ /chu yi phung po'i mngal khur gyis dub 92khun pa'i rang sgras gtsug phud can/ /dga' ba'i gar la ci dgar 'jug pa'i dus ston dus ni gsal byed pa/ /nags kyi dpal mo'i mchu sgros 'dzum las legs bshad dbyangs kyi nga ro 'thon/ 28 /de tshe nam mkha'i nor gyi bu/ /thun mtshams stegs las mchong ma thag /mig sman lan bu sar 'khyil ba'i/ /mtshan mo'i bud med dga' ba'i rgod/ 29 /kun rmongs bzhin du mun pa'i mtha'/ /rim gyis zad pa'i gtam snyan pos/ /khyongs pa'i pho nya khyung sngon skyes/ /'char dus mnal ba'i ming

lam du/30/dar gyi thod bcings rba rā dza//mgul du btags pa btsad po'i gzugs/ /gus pa'i mgrin pa btegs nas des//zhu mchid snyan gyi rol mor spros/sti/gnaga'adir re zhig skyil mo krung //'cha' na kho bos sri zhu bgyid//gal te gshegs na bdag gi bu//dwags la sgam po'i yon gnas mdzod/po/o gsol thabs mkhas thugs rje yi//gzhog brkyangs grub dbang skar mig bu//bla ma'i lung bstan ri'i dbang po//sgam po dar gyi rtse la babs/33/der ni drang srong la 'os pa'i//yid 'bab bste sas bsgrubs sa der//mtshams bcad rdo rje'i sgo glegs la/kho grangs ༅ snyas brten dgongs tsha/34/thal bas lus byugs rma bya'i sgro//lag pa'i pad+mor chags pa yi//mkha' la 'gro ba'i bud med rdzi/ngag gi lam las 'di skad rgyas/35/bcu gnyis 'dag sbyor byas pa

go༅༅/ /bas/ /bcu gnyis bstan pa spel na dga'/ /zhes zer ring min dus kyi tshe/ /skal bar ldan kun cig car tshogs/ 36 /de la zab rgyas dam pa'i bcud bzang po/ /mgron du grims pas nyams rtogs lang tsho'i dpal/ /dkar po'i tshes kyi 'phel ba la bsgrun mthar/ /mchog gi cha kun yongs su gang ba thob/ 37 /sbyangs pa'i yon to du ku la yi gos/ /dran shes nam mkha'i mthongs su brgyangs pa yi/ /grib mar yongs su bsti ba'i bsam gto pa/ /ji snyed 'byung bar lung bstan dus su smin/ 38 /rnam par 'dren pa gang gi sku'i bkod pa/ /sprul bsgyur zad par zil gyis gzhon pa des/ /mo'u gal bu yi rdzu 'phral las 'gongs te/ khukya'i rgyal po la'ang skyengs pa sbyin/ 39 /'dus byas rtag pa min la rtag 'dzin pa'i/ /snying mun can la snying nas khrel ba'i thugs/ /zhidro khams gzhan gyi

wa sku'i snang brnyan sprul pa'i zhing gzhan gshegs/ 40 /mtho ris bu mo'i lag pad kyis gtor ba'i/ /maḥ ra yi char pas mun na sgron mar sbar ba la/ /dga' bas rol mo'i dgrangs kyis rgod pa bzhin/ 41 /zag med yon to phung po 'dis/ /bdag cag smu bas skyo nas nor 'dzin ma/ khugs ring dang bcas 'dar bar 'gyur/ 42 /mkhyen gnyis 'od stong rab 'bar bas/ /tshul shes rab byang zhing chub pa'i rdul/ /gsar pa'i 'jig rten dge bar mdzad/ 43 /dus gsum rnam mkhyen dmi pa/ /'gro ba'i 5 chen po gsal stong pa/ /gsum gyis bstan pa'i srog rtsa 'thud/ 44 dngos lodzin 'byul pa'i dra ba mtha' dag ji lta rtogs pa'i

༄༅༅/ /dbyings su zhig /dngos snang sgru ma'i yul 'bor sna tshogs ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rtsal du shar/ /zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i klong du 'khor 'das zos kun rab rdzogs pa/ /dwags po'i dkar brgyad rin cen 'phreng ba phyogs kyi mdzes ma'i rgyan du longs/ 45 /thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa rabs n+t+ra 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dga'i 'khri shing las/ sgam po pa bsod nams rin chen gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste drug pa'o// //ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba phyar tsam gyis/ /'jigs tshogs lta ba'i ri bo kun zhig nas/ /yang dag bde mnyam thang las rnam grol gli /gling du 'jug la klan shar byed pa su/ 1 /stobs kyi srid pa gyen du 'degs bzod gyad kyi dpa' bo lha rab dga'/ /chos dashar 'od kyis gsal snang spro mkhas grub pa'i zla ba ye shes

dbang / /mkhyen pa rab kyis 'jam dpal la 'gran gsang ba gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /rgyal bstan shing rta bho ṭar 'dren la brtson 'grus seng ge'i rigs de bzang / 2 /de ni srid las khyad par du/ /'phags pa'i dpal nor bcu gsum gyis/ /bkra shis me tog gsar pa'i 'phreng / /dus su smin legs khu le'i ljongs/ 3 /nor sbyin dbang po'i khang pa brtsegs/ /gangs ri'i zol gyis lhun chags pas/ /dbyig gi khu ba'i gru char gyis/ /lhung lhung sgra ldan rgyun 'bab bskyed/ 4 /sngo ljang myu gu'i gos rgyan pas/ /nor 'dzin lha mo'i mdzes sdug gis/ /mtho ris lang tsho'i dpal thams cad/ /phyogs te rang gir byas sam snyam/ 5 /lhag bsam ltar darkan 'o ma yi/ /mchod sbyin lan drod mngal gyi dzon/ /ā ṭ+wāṃ 'bar ba'i rnam 'phrul 'di/ /spral pa'i ra mas lung du bstan/ snyo /der

ra༅༅/ /ni rgya yul gyad rigs thig le zhig /gan logs zhes bya'i phyags lhas dgazha tshal du/ /ngo mtshar grod pa'i rgya ldan btsas ma thag /ring phur drod kyis bsod nams bzhin du smin/ 7 /rab sgom rgya mthun bag chags tshon ris 'bum/ /rnam dpyod pir gyis bris pa'i ya mtshan la/ /sred pa 'gog slad sra mkhregs rdo ba'i ngos/ /zhabs mthil 'khor lo'i re kha shesar du bskrun/ 8 /khu lung par grags rtog ge'i slob da' las/ /sde bdun rigs pa'i bcud kun 'thungs pa ste/ /blo gsal rgya mtshor skyugs las mtshan snyan po/ shes rab bdud rtsi'i 'khor lo zhes su thogs/ 9 /bshes gnyen rta thang pa dang lhan gyi so/ /dar ma seng ge la sogs mkhas mang gi/ /zhal sgror chu ba'i chos tshul bdud rtsi'i mtsho/ /blo gros ri byi'i khyor bar yud kyis song / 10 /lha yi chu bo 'bab pa'i tshu rol na/ /do zla

dben pa'i grub thob gling ras pa/ /pad+ma rdo rje'i zhal gyi bcud mtha' dag /rgya ras ye shes rdo rje'i thugs su smin/ 11 /gsal stong nam mkha' dwangs bar bde drod kyi/ /zla nyi cig car shar ba'i 'od po ches/ /mtshan rtog mun pa'i bu mo sun phyung nas/ /rtogs pa'i ye shes da gdod mthong zhes gdams/ 12 /rig pa 'dzin gtso dpal dang ldan pa'i rngog /rdo rje seng ges dgyes gdan mahā mā ya'i/ /dbang bskur rgyud bshad gzhom med nā da'i dbyangs/ /snyan par bsgrags de thos 'dzin snod du lhung / 'a /ljo phyogs dung gi brag ri mkhar gzings pas/ /chu 'dzin lto ba dral ba'i khrag rgyun la/ /'thung bar rngams pa'i phra men srin mo'i gdong / /mig sman gos su rgyan rnams rgya ba'i srang / yon te ba'i gnas chen de wi ko ṭa'i zhing / /skyong mdzad nā ga rak+ṣa dur khrod sgi /bdag mor rtsedaga'i ro la rjes chags pa'i/ /'dun pa

dbang phyug dgyes pa'i gnas/ 15 /e gsang lcags phur can du lcags phur bzhin/ /brtan par snas pa'i rgyal mtshan 'ordzo mthu la brgal 'dod pa'i/ /dbang phyug sder bcas dpung gi snyems pa ngom/ 16 /dpal mgon khros pa' smin ma 'khyog bskyod 5/ /lha mo nag mos gtum drag dmag gis srid gsum g.yo ba'i cho 'phral stoni/ /mi sdug mgo brnyan rnam mang mtshon 'phen mi dro ra bcas srog ldan bzhin du 'gul 'chom ldeg pa'i drag shul sdom/ 17 /srid gsum khros pa'i dus kyi khar/ /za ba'i mche ba mar gzigs la de/ /ye shes rtsal chen 'byams su klas/ 18 /de tshe der dus 'byung po'i sdes/ /glags ma rnyed la phan tshun

du/ /gtam gyi 'jug pa de dang de/ /gleng lce gar gyi rnam 'gyur mang / 19 /sus kyang brdzir med 'di la 'dir/ /rdo rje go cha su yis byin/ /thub pa bdud kyi bdud de slar/ /kye ma kye hud 'ongs sam ci/ 20 /zhes smra sbrang bu'i gzhog rlabs kyis/ /lhun po bsgyel ba'i da/'a thub la/ /sgyid lug gnyid kyis myos pa'i glal/ /rang nyams bzhin du gyi nar phyar/ lto /skabs der dngos po'i gnas lugs sgrib bral du/ /mngon gyur de tshe phyi nang rten 'byung gis/ /drag cing rtsub pa'i sematha'achang bdud rigs kha/ /dam chos skyong ba'i phyogs su 'dzum zhing bsgyuX/ lto /'jig rten 'drid pa'i chos brgyad dug sdong gi/ kho ba 'byin byed ro snyoms mtshon ngar ma/ /gter rgyas btab pa byung na skal ldan kun/ /zung 'jug mthon par 'dzegs pa'i thabs su sbyar/ sa /de nas ḍā ki ni dang nyi zer gyi/ 'ang rta bcings pa'i grub thob

ra༅༅/ /gling gi bshas/ /mkha' spyod tsa rir bzhud ces bskul mthar bod/ /kha gsum bzhul thag ring yang yud kyis bcad/ 24 /gnyis snang bdud rtsir 'thung spyod tsa ri trar/ /brtul zhugs rol pa'i gar gyi ror chags pas/ /bdud bcom thar pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng bzhin du/ /dag pa'i gzigs mo mtha' yas gtan la phab/ 25 /gdengs can cher khros mi sdug sbal pa'i gzugs/ /thar lam 'gegs pa bzhin du mdun 'ongs pa/ /dpa' bo'i gar rgyas brdzis mthar 'bigs byed ri/ /rgud 'drar zhabs mthil rtags kyi lan mang spud/ 26 /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i 'khor lo yongs rdzogs bde chen dbyengs su sdom pa'i dpal/ /dag pa shel gyi ri bo'i ngogs su nyis stong brgyad brgya'i lhar snang ba/ /dbang sngon me long phyis pa'i nang du pra brgyad babs pa'i mig la bzhin/ /dag pa'i snang ba dkar po

'byams klas sgyu ma'i 'phral 'di yongs mi shes/ 27 /zung 'dzin bsad pa'i khrag dmar rgyun/ /'thung la rab dgyes dpa' bo'i grong / /g.yu mcho g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal la'i/ /'od kyi phung pos ༄phyogs kun gsal/ 28 /gdung byed reg byas mkha' bzhu ba'i/ /khu ba lud pa'i rba rlabs 'dzum/ /bzhad ldan mtsho ltar snang yang de/ /bde chen rgyal po'i pho brang dngos/ 29 /der ni zla tshes thod can lhas/ /bskal bzang sgron ma mos par khyod/ /rdzogs 'tshang rgya zhes lung bstan gyi/ /rnga dgrangs 'jig rten gsum du bsgrags/ 30 /brtul zhugs grub pa rgya ras pa'i/ /bstan pa bya thode gzhog rlabs kyis/ /bcad pa'i nyin lam bco brgyad du/ /khyab ces wā ra his lung bstan/ sti /li khri'i mtsho las chu sngar bzhin/ /rang byung mkha' 'gros mig ra'i rgya/ /'ching grol med pa'i brda thabs dang / /lhan cig sgrab pa'i phug

ra༅༅/ /chen phul/ 32 /gsang ba chen po'i gzhal med khang brtsegs bde chen rgyal po'i khab/ /kha sbyor yan lag rin chen bdun ldan dpal gyi 'gyor pas phyug /grangs med rigs la dbang bsgyur rgyal thabs mchog tu grub pa'i yum/ /rdo rje'i btsun mo'i snang cha rnam 'dzin lhun stug ri'i dbang por/ 33 /'gyur med bde chen rang gzugs he ru sha'i/ /rang bzhin kha ṭaṃ ga 'dra'i shing drung du/ /rdo rje'i skyil krung gcig gis dgun zla gsum/ /mnyam nyid klong du mnyam par gzhag tshe der/ 34 /bsung zhim sprin sngon 'khrigs pa'i zlogrin par lha'i/ /rol sgra 'brag gi na chung glu len pas/ /spyan drangs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun/ /mkha' la gzha' ris bzhin du gsal ba gzigs/ 35 /de yis rten cing 'brel rābyung chos sgo brgyad/ /cig car phye ba'i nang du skal ldan yongs/ /rgyags

pa'i sgra la smo byed rna ba de'ang / /'chi med 'gram pa'i grogs po snying du sdug 36 /ji lta rtogs pa'i ye shes ā dar+sha/ /blos byas rdul gyi ma rnyogs mngon thob der/ /ji snyed chos kun gzigs mo 'dis tshims pas/ /mkhyen pa gnyis ldan mchog gi dngos po grub/ 37 /rtogs pa'i ba dan mtho yang klan gzhi rlung / khugs cher longs na rnal du ci ste gnas/ /drang srong rgyal mtshan brtan por 'dzin pa gang / /lhar bcas mchod pa'i yul du 'jebs par dgongs/ 38 /brtson 'grus grags pa'i nga ro srid pa'i rtser/ /lud pa'i mkhan slob zhang dang rtsi 'dul las/ /bsnyen par rdzogs thob ngur smig mtshams sprin gyis/ /ye shes rdo rje'i ri so yud kyis klabs/ 39 /nā ro paṇa chen zur phud lag pa'i rtser/ /len po nga min su zhes gzengs mthong bcas/ /dgyes 'dzum bzhin du dkar ba'i rgod ma yi/ 'ang rta dgazha

ra༅༅/ /tshal gung gi thang la rgyugs/ 40 /skabs der 'jig rten gsum mgon 'bri khung pas/ /mings zhes rjes gdams dkar brgyad cod pan gyis/ /gtsug tor dkris pa'i dge mtshan la gzhung ba'i/ /tshig 'phreng 'di skad mkhan po'i zhal las rgyus/ 41 /rgod po nam 'phang spyod pa'i zhwa zlosdi ltas/ /yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'gengs par sems na yang / /rgad bu g.yas chung byis pa'i kun spyod la/ /'chol ring de de'i lam las gzhan du gol/ 42 /da ste rta mig dbyebs kyi rjes 'gro'i zhwa/ /rgya rtags dbang gi rgyal po 'di lta bu/ /skrun pa'i sdom brtson snar 'gror spyod pa yis/ /sa chen khyab par rdzun bral lung du bstan/ 43 /las kyi slob dpon zhal gyi bum bzang las/ /legs gsungs 'dul ba'i chab rgyan gtsang dwangs bas/ /kha na ma tho'i dri ro kun sbyangs mthar/ /gnas brtan nye bar

gsor gyi do zlar chas/ 44 /dpa' bo'i gan gyis rnam rol skye med zhang / /bde ba'i rdo rje'i thugs bcud gdams pa'i gnad/ /zab dang yang zab shin tu zab mtha' yas/ /dri bral dgongs pa'i snying por rgya yis btab/ 45 /bka' drin gdengs ka phyar ba'i 'byung gnas las/ /sems can chos dang dmigs med snying rje'i klong / /rdol des ris med 'gro la gnyen gzhin pas/ /ma 'dris mdza' zhing bshes pa'i thu sor grub/ 46 /dus gsum dus med mkhyen pa dbu se'i zhabs/ /bsnyen las 'byung 'gyur lung du bstan bzhin 'brug /se ba byang chub gling gi gtsug lag khang / /phan bde'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i snod du sprul/ 47 /'dun ma'i yang rtser 'phags pa'i rtse bo lar/ /chos kyi rje 'di 'dzegs tshe 'byug mad dgus/ /snyan grags lta bur che ba mkha'i rnga dbyangs/ /kun gsal pha mtha' tshol ba'i ched du

gzhi la/ /babs par 'khrul pa'i mi ma yin/ /nyin yang mtshan mo'i 'du shes kyis/ /bsam /rlung gis bskyod 'dra'i rab byung sde/ /dus su 'du ba'i brda' thabs su/ /dar chen ri bo'i rtse chen lha dang klu'i/ /'jig rten dang ni 'jig rten khams/ /gzhan dang gzhan du lan gsum sung thel/ /grub pa'i mchod sdong 'og min rdzi /mtshungs zla 'os pa sa la bskrun/ 52 /de smu ska'i zla nya nub phyogs chu ldan lha yis mgroni du bos pa na/ /kun gsal bu mo snamadza' bas ma

bzod mtshams sprin yol ba bres shing slar/ /me tog char dang rol mo'i sgra yis phyogs kyi 'khor lo mdzes par byas/ 53 /rgyal ba kun 'dus snying po'i gdung dam pa / /yid bzhin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i nor bu de/ /gtsang bar byed pa'i byi dor gyis mchod pas/ /dgos dgu ma tshang med pa char du babs/ 54 /sgrib pa bral thugs legs bshad smra ba'i ljags/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan 'bras dang bcas pa/ /byin za'i kha yis cung zad ma god par/ /'gro gsum mchod bya nyid du rnam par gsal/ 55 /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i dpal/ /haṃ yig zla tshes dkar po'i gzhal med khang / /rnam par sbyangs pa'i ngos la rigs gsum zhi /mgon po mkhyen brtse nus pa'i pir gyis bris/ 56 /ska tshigs rin chen brtsegs ma nyer gcig khrir/ /'jig rten kun la spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /thugs rje 'bur du

༄༅༅/ /dod pa'i ngo mtshar mthu/ /dpe bral nyi shu rtsa gnyig lhun gyis grub/ 57 /legs byas bzhin du ji snyed 'phel ba'i gdung / /kha dog rnam mang 'od kyi dra ba can/ /lus can bsod nams sa bon bskrus pa'i zhing / /yangs pa'i sa chen 'di la khyab par gdal/ 58 /thog mtha' bar du che ba'i bu chen drug /ras pa rnal 'gror zhig po gsum phrag gsum/ /gdugs kya bkur sti theg pa'i dbu che ni/ /nyis stong brgyad brgya gzhan ni mu mtha' yas/ 59 /chos kyi khri la mngon par dbang bskur rgyal tshab dam pa sangs rgyas dboni/ /gnam gyi skar ma'i grangs la 'gran pa'i stod 'brag shing rta rgod tshang pa/ /sa yi dreg pa lta bur rgya che'i smad 'brag srol 'byed lo ras pa/ /phul byung ring lugs srid pa'i mthar yang rgyas 'di 'byug pa'i dkar brgyad zlo/ 60 /thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bsnyan

yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa rabs kyi 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dgazhi 'khri shing las/ gdung dang na bza'i mtshan can gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste bdun pa'o// //byang chen spyod la gzhol ba'i snying stobos snang bas mdzod/ gar ba tsam gyis 'gro ba'i snying la nyal ba yi/ sprun rmongs mun pa'i go 'phang zhig pa'i sgra boche/ /srid pa'i gtsug tor rnam gnon mchog tu rgyal gyur cig 1 ta/kya'i tog tu 'phags pa thub dbang gis/ /smon lam stobs kyis bzung ba'i 'jig rten khams/ /zug rngus rnam par mi mjed zhing 'di na/ /mi nub shar gyi phyogs su sangs rgyas zhing / 2 /ji snyed bgrang ba'i mtha' der 'jig rten gyi/ /khams mchog thos bsam dran pa tsam gyis kyang / /mngon par dgazha ba'i bde ba sbyin nus pa/ /rnam dag zhing khams phun tshogs ldan pa yod/ 3 /de yi stoni pas sangs rgyas spyan

ra༅༅/ /chen po'i/ /spyan sngar byang chub dam par thugs bskyed nas/ /spyad pa spyod tshe brnag dasha'i smon lam gyi/ /go cha lhag bsam rnam par dkar bas bzhes/ 4 /sems can 'ga' tsam la'ang khong khro bas/ /'khrags pa'i sems ni bdag gis skusnangs mi bgyid/ /gal te de lta min na sangs rgyas kun/ /bslus par gyur ces dam bca' dmod du bor/ 5 /de nas nyer bzurjo 'khon 'dzin rlung gi lces/ /cung zad mi bskyod rgya cher mi 'khrags phyir/ /mi 'khrags par grags mtshan gyi dge legs ches/ /nam mkha'i mtha' gru 'jal ba'i dalakha thub blangs/ 6 /de nas de ni mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i༄/ /byang chub shing dbarjo rin chen bdun rang bzhin/ /chos kyi sgra chen sgrogs pa dpag bya'i tshad/ /'bum phrag gyen du langs pa'i rna cha 'dzin/ 7 /snyigs ma'i 'dam gyis ma rnyogs mngon dgazhi

mtsho/ /lta ngan 'dzin khris ma slad ngan 'gro yi/ /ba tshwa'i ro bral yid mi 'ong ba'i cha/ /phra mo tsam yang dmigs su ga la yodi/ 8 /gser gyi khu bas brlan pa sa yi gzhir/ /reg pas bde ster 'chi med gos zung 'drar/ /ngo mtshar me rtog 'phreng ba'i rgyan bkod pas/ /mdzes pa las kyang 'gongs te lhag par mdzes/ 9 /khor yug rin chen pha gus skyor ba'i rdzing bu khrus kyi 'bab stegs can/ /zla zer khu ba sa la 'khyil 'dra'i yan lag brgyad ldan chus gang ba/ shel gyi me long dri med nyid du 'bral ba'i rmongs pa skyed byed 'gram/ /'dzom bu na dī'i bye ma'i mdangs kyis chu bya'i tshogs kyang gser mdog 'dzin/ 10 /sngo ljang gsal ba'i 'dab 'phreng 'di ci ne( tsho'i gzhog rlabs bskyod min nam/ /sbrang rtsi'i bu rnams zlos gar rtsen pa me rtog 'dab brgya grol ba'i tshal/ /yid rab 'phrog pa'i chom rkun min nam rin chen rang

༄༅༅/ /bzhin man+da ra/ /bsung zhim ngad kyis phyogs kyi 'khor lo skal bzang byed pa'i rnam 'phrul rtsom/ 11 /yal 'dab rnam rgyas puṣ+ṭa sha'i/ /ze'u 'brar smin legs 'bras bu'i khur/ /g.yur du za ba'i gdugs dkar gli /grib ma ngal 'tsho'i ched du bsil/ 12 /ci 'dod sbyin pa'i yal gzhi lag /ring por bskyongs pa dpag bsam gyi/ /'khri shing gzhon nu'i lding khang rnams/ /'jig rten byed pos gsar du sprul/ 9 /nor bu'i ljon 'phreng lta na sdug /rlung gis bskyod pas snyan 'jebs sgras/ /yid la chags pa'i dpal ster ba/ /'di ste legs byas mthu las 'ongs/ 14 /gangs ri g.yo 'dra'i lag ldan sde/ /spu sdug gos rgyani ri dwags khyu/ /mdangs mdzes 'dab chags rgya ba rnams/ /sngal pa'i gar yin ngan 'grerdzo min/ 15 /badz+ra hi ra serdzogs rin chen/ /sna bdun las grub gzhal med

khang / /brtsegs 'phar rgya phubs twa ra ṇa'i/ /zer gyis srid pa'i mun pa phrogs/ 16 /rin chen tog gi 'od kun tu/ /'bar bas rang gi gnas phyogs pas/ /mthon mthing gnam gyi bla re de/ /lhungs samakhyams kyimathil 'di sngo/ 7 /de la pad rtsa ltar dkar ba'i/ /tshon gyis mig mangs re khā mtshar/ /mthing mtshor dbu ba'i 'dzum dkar gyis/ /dge legs phyogs brgyar 'grems pa 'dra/ 18 /an+da rnyil gyi bya 'dab 'od/ /nor bu'i rtsig ngos la 'phos pa/ /ut+pal sngone pos nags tshal du/ /'khrul pas ra yig gnyis pa bslad/ 19 /gser gyi ba gam 'od tshogs mthus/ /bar snang de phyogs lhung ba la/ /sprin dkar dang 'dres mda' yab rtses/ /gnam sngon grogs su yud kyis sbran/ 20 /dra phyed glog gi gar mkhan ma'i/ /'og lpags las 'phyang dril chung sgras/ /kun rmongs zad pa'i gtam snyan

ra༅༅/ /po/ /srid gsum rna ba'i dbyed du bsgrags/ lto /mkha' lding gnas kyi mchod sdong lta'i/ /khang brtsegs sna tshogs 'od snang can/ /bgrang mtha' yas par nor bu'i khrir/ /mal stan lha yi 'dun sa bzhin/ lto /'dod 'ong rjes 'brang mi 'dod tshe/ /mi snang 'dod pa ltar byed pa'i/ /skyed tshal rdzing bu'i kho ra yug /mya ngan med shing phreng ba'i mdzes/ sa /bsung zhim khyongs pa'i dri'i shing rta/ /'jam bde sgoms pa'i reg bya can/ /ldang ngam yang na zhi 'gyur ba/ /bzhed dang bzhed min rjes su 'gro/ 24 /lha'am 'on te mi gang zhes/ /phur bu'i blos kyang dpyad dasha' ba/ /mdzes sdug rdzogs pa'i skyes bud med/ /skyon bral lang tsho'i dpal 'ordzongs spyod/ 25 /blta ba'i rtse dgas rab tshim pa'i/ /mngal gyi khang bur nyin zhag bdun/ /'dzin pa'i ma yang bsam gtan gli /dga' ba nyams su

myong bzhin bde/ 26 /lhag bsam ltar dkar ngang pa'i khyus/ /mgrin rnga brdung dang lhan cig tu/ ang pa drug pasagar bsgyur ba'i/ /mchod sprin pad+ma'i mtsho las spro/ 27 /mtshan dpe'i 'od phung kun tu 'bar bas nyi zla'i snang ba zum par byed/ /nor 'dzin dpal mo'i bzhin rgyas me long phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i gzugs kyis gang / /sprin bzhin mkha' la 'chi med grong khyer bkode legs dpal gyi char 'bab pa'i/ /bar du rin chen them skas mdzes par 'gro dang 'ong ba'i bya ba bsgrub/ 28 /de lta'i mdun sar dgeg pa'i stoni pa mchog /bdud bzhi'i rkyen brgyas mi 'khrugs bcome ldan 'das/ /in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po mtshams sprin gyis/ zhakhyud 'dra skye dgazhi bsod nams gzugs ldan bzhin/ wo /yongs sbyangs be+eshār gtsang ma'i rngul brtsegs ngos/ /mtshan dpe'i ri mo byed pos bris nas slar/ /glog 'od gos kyis

/klubs pa ma yal na/ /mi bskyod rgyal po khyod kyi rjes su 'gro/ 30 /stobs bcu pa de'i sras kyi thu bo pa/ /'gro ba'i khur chen 'degs bzod bal glang spos kyi glang chen dang 'grogs nas/ bskal chen 'bum bcur byang chen spyod pas mtsho/ sti /rigs can gsum 'dus 'khor gyi dkyil tshogs theg pa'i 'jug sgo bgrang yas kyi/ /chos tshul brgya phrag 'doms pas skad cig la'ang / /nyon mongs dgra bcom 'bras bus sim pa 3/ tan phung pos lcid pa'i chu khur can/ /rgya che'i dbus na bdud rtsi'i bcud 'dzag pa/ /'jig rten dbang phyug snying rje'i chu ris can/ /snang ba rdul bral mar bzung / 33 /byang chub spyod la bslab tshul lha'i chu bo/ /yongs rdzogs 'thung nus sems dpa' chen po khyod/ /drang srong dzasno ste gzhan don

du/ /ma god slar yang skyug pa'i cho ga mdzod/ 34 khyams pa'i cha yangs gang bas zla ba dang / /snying rje'i 'od phung 'bar bas nyi ma dang / khyang chub sems mtha' med pas mkha' 'dra khyodi/ /yid can kun la 'dris pa med pa'i bshes/ 35 /sbyin pas chags med bsil ba'i go 'phang brnyes/ /tshul khrims gtsang bas kun gyi yi ga 'gugs/ /khyod kyis bzod par mi nus chos gang zhes/ /tshol phyir ngoms pa med pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam / 36 /g.yeng ba'i rlung gis mi g.yo bsam gto gyi/ /ri bo shes rab rtse mo'i mkha'i ya thog /rnam gnon thabs la mkhas pa'i stobs mthu ches/ /smoni lam ye shes mchog gi pha rol phyin/ 37 /dbang bcu la sogs yon to rin chen gyi/ /'byung gnas gting mtha' mi mngon thugs rje'i rlabs/ /ris med mkha' la 'byud pa'i sems dpa' che'i/ /snang bas rngul gyi rnyog ma

ra༅༅/ /kun dang bral/ 38 7bas chen byang chub mchog gi spyod pa la/ /longs su spyod phyir sangs rgyas zhing nas zhing / /brgyud nas chos kyi bdud rtse 'thung bzhin du/ /zhing sbyang smon rdzogs gdul bya smin par mdzad/ 39 /'phags pa la 'os nor gyi bu rnams bdun/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sbyangs gzhan phan sgo /rgyal mtshan tog tu mchod pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /dgos dgu char du 'bebs mkhas khyod bsngags so/ 40 /drang srong dgra bcom rang rgyal gli /sbyangs pa'i yon to bdog kun dang / /rgyal ba'i sras kyi snying stobs phul/ sprun gyis mi mtshon khyod kho na/ 41 /thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa rabs kyi 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dga'i 'khri shing las/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po snang ba rdul bral gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste brgyad

pa'o// /khun lakhyaga'ajug rnamapa thamasacad mkhyen ye shes/ /cig car gzigs pa'i chos kyispyan ldan dza yen+d+ra/ /dpal gyi lag pas 'gro la dam 'byud rmongs ༅ klu/ /mthar byed shing rtas mkha' spyod bgrod pa de la 'dud/ 1 /de yang sa gzhir po ṭa la'i/ /dpal kun 'phos gang de la ni/ /grub pa mchog mang sangs rgyas ༅/ /gnas r+pā byang chub snying po'i spo/ 2 /ra lung zhes bya rdo rje'i gdan/ /phun tshogs chu klung 'du ba'i mtsho/ min nas khyad 'phags ༅ gsum gli /rba rlabs srid rtse'i dpal du mtho/ 3 /de yi grib ma'i snum bag gi/ /nags tshal skyong byed dpa' bo stag /ngal 'tshor bsti ba'i tshang mal du/ /rtsal ldan mche ba'i stobs kyis snyems/ 4 /rgya rigs thig le shes rab kyi/ /'od bzang 'phro 'du'i stsol 'khor du/ /ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba'i lha/ /slar yang cho ga rdzogs las

ra༅༅/ /'brangs/ 5 /skyes rabs 'phreng ba mang brgyus pa'i/ /bag chags rin chen srad bu des/ /'dir ni gzhung lugs nam mkha'i mtha'/ /'ching byed zhags pa'i bya ba bsgyubs/ 6 /yab rje'i zhal nas rgya ba'i chos/ /mtha' dag thugs kyi bcud du smin/ /lo brgyad lon tshe seng ge'i khrir/ /'dzegs nas legs bshad tshogs su bsgrags/ 7 /sna tshogs 'khral pa'i lju ba smig rgyu bzhin/ /rnam par g.yo gang rang bzhin shes pas zhig /mngon rtogs nam mkha'i dbyings su zung 'jug gi/ /rnal 'gror nyi ma ji bzhin lham me bsta/ 8 /yon tan sangs rgyas zhes bya'i zhal skyin mtsho/ /srub skyesazla ba gsar pa'i cha rer yang / /man ngag bsil zer bye ba 'dzag pa'i rgyan/ /'thungs pa'i tsa ko ra bzhin lang tsho brtas/ 9 /grub rigs dbyed kyi thig ler skyes khyod kyis/ /brgyad pa'i srol bzang 'di ko mi

gcod na/ /nyams su len bya'i snying po mos gas la/ /chos kun rdzogs pa 'di rang gyis zhes gdams/ 10 /snang bzhin srid pa'i chos la phyag rgya yis/ /'debs byed lhan cigaskyes pa'i dbyings dgapar/ /rab spyor cho gardzogs pas lta ba'i mkhar/ /rtogs pa'i gdung ring bskor bsabazhed dgongs grub/ 11 /chos kyi mdun sa bde ba can gyi grwa'i/ /smra ba'i seng ge slob dpon bde rings pa/ /lugs ngan za bar goms pa'i kha lnga yis/ /gad brgyangs mthon por sgrogs pa de las 'dir/ 12 /smra sgo 'byed pa'i lde mig sgyu bsdus 'phreng / /mdo bcas sde bdun rig pa'i mtshon cha sogs/ /rgya bod bstan bcos du ma'i tshig dang r+pā/ /blo gros snyim pas ngom par gsol de yis/ d+ku /sbyongs dang lhan skyes spobs pa'i mkha'i rgyal mtshan/ /rnam dpyod chu ris 'khyog por g.yo ba las/ /lung mang rdo rje'i sgrar

ra༅༅/ /bcas rigs pa'i thog /phab pas rgol bar 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sbyin/ 14 /blo gros brtan pa zhesabod zhethang pa/ /de sras sgra pa a mo gha pa bcas/ /bston nas brda sprod snyan tshig mngon brjod sogs/ /tha snyad rigs tshul kun gyi pha mthar phyin/ 15 /rgya dang bod kyi yul 'khor la brten pa'i/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i tog tu khyod 'thon pas/ /sgra bsgyur rtsom 'chad snang ba dkar po yis/ /ston zla gang ba'i dregs pa thung ngur byas/ 16 /mar ston bshad rgyun sarba mukyi dzi'i/ /do shal mags du 'phyang ba rngog ston che/ /bdun mthar byon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal/ /byang chub dpal zhabs rin chen gtsug tu bsten/ 17 /na tshod khur lcis dub kyang da bar du/ /lnga pa'i gnas skabs ngal gso mi bston par/ /khyod la sgag sdod dganya spyad kho nar zad/ /da ni chos nor bdag por gtod do gsung / 18 /

rgyud drug dkyil 'khor bdun gyi gsang ba'i gnad/ /ma tshang med pas gang ba'i bum bzang bcud/ /rgyal dbang thugs su byo bas rgyud sde kun/ /'chad pa'i rdo rje'i slob da' nyid du grub/ 19 /lnga rig sbyangs pa'i phul phyin paṇ+ḍi ta/ /rdo rje btsun mos mchog sbyin rgyal tsho sras/ /nags kyi rin chen dad pa'i rgyal ma' rtser/ /bkon pa'i 'od ris srid pa'i mthar yang song / 20 /sa bcu'i go 'phang 'dzegs pa sems dpa' che/ /rnam 'grel skor gsum gzhan yang mdo rgyud sgra'i/ /dga' gnad nang gi mun nang 'khyams pa kun/ /nyin mo'i snang ba dkar pos dbugs 'byin mdzad/ 21 /bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba'i cod pan las/ /gzhon nu'i mtshan can lhab lcab dar dpyangs zung / /legs bshad rlung gis bskyod pa'i sgra mthon pos/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i gting dpogs gtam du bsnyad/ lto /btsun mkhas grub

ra༅༅/ /pa'i nor ldan gzhan mang las/ /chos tshul dbyig gi phung po kun bzhes nas/ /srid pas rgud rnams sdug bsngal zhi ba'i sman/ /char du bsnyil ba'i dge mtshan yongs la rngom/ nar /gnas gzhir 'du 'aci'i ro la rjes chags pa'i/ /mi srun chos brgyad khol por thugs 'bu bas/ /phyogs bral bstan pa'i snying po phyogs kun tu/ /'dzugs phyir khor yug cog bu'i 'phreng ba spel/ 24 /bcu drug cha ldan shel gyi khang brtsegs mun pa 'phrog pa'i chom rkun de/ /sngo sangs g.yen ma'i char g.yeng la skyo nor 'dzin bu mor rtse 'dod pas/ /yid 'bab ras dkar phra ma'i grol gyi ne'u gsing g.yu yi maṇ+ḍa lar/ /bsil ba'i zer ngang lhan cig babs pas phyogs 'dzin 'dam las skyes rnams nyams/ 25 /de mthong skar ma'i tshogazlo thams cad/ /rgya skar bdag po'i rjes 'brangs nas/ /rang 'od 'phro

/ga cog bu'i snang cha 'dzin/ 26 /de lta'i bkod legs ldan pa'i sgar/ /dkar po'i snang bas phyogs cha kun/ /zla ba'i go 'phang la gas su bstan/ 27 /dkar brgyud kun gyi gtsug tor la/ /zhabs sen zla tshes 'od kyi zer/ /'bab stegs byed pa sgam po pa'i/ //8 /ye shes nam mkha'i khams kun tu/ /myur 'gro'i tshig gis bskul bzhin des/ /bde chen ha har bzhad gnas rdzi /sgo glegs su sbra zhes bya pha bong mtho/ /'bigs byed gzhan pa lta bu'i rtser/ badzegs pa'i stabs su zhabs kyi khung / /'jim pa la bzhin gsal ma'i ngang tshul du/ /gzigs pa yongs dag grub thob kyi/ /'khor los bskyar ba lcags zam pa/ /thang stong rgyal pos khyod zhabs

ra༅༅/ /bsnyen/sti /de dang badz+ra wā ra lha'i/ /smyu 'phral gar gyi rol mo mkhan/ /kun dga' bzang mo dang ni gzhan/ /'chi ba med pa tsha sgrub pa / tso/la sogs gsor gyi tswa7 'khor la/ /rdo rje tshon pa'i sa dgerwa ra/ /khrid tshul chen po brgyad 'doms de'i/ /khyad chos reg zig nyid du btab/33/gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa dug gi chu//bdud rtsir 'thung spyod tsa ri tra/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyigatsor//'phags pa'i dgazha ston longs su spyad/34/rtsa rlung khams la rang dbang du/ /gyur pa'i rnam shes skyes bu de/ /gzhan lus grong la 'jug pa'i 'phral/ /bston med sbrang bu'i ro la sad/35/dag pa'i snang ba rab tu 'byams pa'i gzhan dbang las/ /rnam mang lhag pa'i lha dang grub gnyis mngon thob pa'i/ zlo/ ma rnams dang mngon sum bzhin du chos kyi gtam/ /bgro bar

mdzad pa'i rnam thar 'di ste gzhan pas lhag 36 /sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing ring po sa gsum du/ /btsugs pa'i dge mtshan srid rtser lud mthar zhe dgu'i lo/ /ngo mtshar ltas kyi 'phreng bas bsus te chos dbyings zhir/ /re zhig ngal gsor bsti ba'i skyil krung rgya cher bcas/ 37 /gsung gi bdud rtsis blo gros lus brtas pa/ /mkhan po dge slong bla ma rtogs ldan ras/ /zung dang mthu bo che ni mi gcig ste/ /che phra'i slob tshogs bgrang byas ga la dpogs/ 38 /kun gyi thu bor sems dpa' kun tu bzang / /grub chen tosbyi mar stoni grub pa'i rje/ /dar ma seng shes sgrub brgyud dar slad du/ /ngag dbang chos gyi dzol por ngag don grub/ 39 /tshul gnas khrims kyi gos bzang bgos/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rgyan gyi sgeg /mkhas btsun grub pa'i yone tan mtho/ /kun dga' dpal 'gyor dar bab 'o 40 /

༄༅༅/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dpag bsam dbang po thub bstan yongs 'du'i dpal gyi sde'i skyes pa rabs kyi 'phreng ba ngo mtshar rtse dga'i 'khri shing mos/ rgyal dbang kun dgazha dpal 'gror gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab ste dgu pa'o// //sa gsum dbang por bcas pa yongs kyi gong ma'i gong mar mngon 'phags pa'i/ /phun tshogs chos kyi grags pa'i rnga dgrangs yan lag drug cu'i rjes 'gro'i skad/ /mngon par mtho bas chos kyi rgyal thabs nges legs nor bus dbang phyug ces/ /snyan pa'i rang sgra 'brug tu ldir 'di nam mkha'i snod du ga la shong / 1 /sa la bde 'gro'i grong khyer lta na sdug /sgyu ma'i rig pas sprul gang mi 'jig par/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas byin rlabs gnyal gyi dbus/ /chos rgyal lhan po grags pa bzhin du mtho/ 2 /dpal 'gror chu klung kun 'dus rgya mtsho bzhin/ /legs byas

phung por 'phyangs pas ri rab bzhin/ /gzi byin mtshungs pa med pas nyi zla bzhin/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal byed khang bzang bzhin/ 3 /der ni rgyal phran stong gi spyi co la/ /ba/'a rtags nor bu'i cod pan 'ching goms pa/ /mkha' lding rigs kyi thig 'phreng ma nyams pa'i/ /stobs kyi rgyal po bya pa zhes grags pa/ 4 /gzi byin nye ma 'bum phrag bdo ba yi/ /dpung pas 'jig rten gsum po gzung nus pa'i/ /rin chen bdun ldan 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i lha/ /bkra shis dar rgyas legs pa'i rgyal po dang / 5 /thu mi'i rigs kyi lcam mo myur skyob ma/ /mdzes sdug zla ris rdzogs pa dpal gyi yum/ /lhan cig rtse dgazhi 'khri shing gsar pa las/ /sngon med ngo mtshar lha yi me tog 'khrungs/ 6 /dang po'i tshes la zla ba'i cha bzhin du/ /rim gyis de ni lang tsho'i dpal rab 'phel/ /bag chags bzang po'i tshon ris rnam bkra bas/ /

༄༅༅/ /mig dang yid dbang rab dgazhi dbyed 'jor gyur/ 7 /snying rje'i bud shing las mched khro ba'i me/ /tsha yang snying la bsil ba'i dpal 'god phyer/ /ljags rtser 'thab pa'i grol gyis spring yig gcig /'phangs des phyogs brgyar khyab pa'i rdzu 'phrul mdzad/ 8 /skad cig de la rgyal dbang slob ma ni/ /brgya phrag brgyad 'dus rje de'i yang srid du/ /nges pa'i shes pas drangs pa'i dad stobs rdzi 'ang rta gyen du bgrod pa'i skal bzang thob/ 9 /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal por mtshan gsol de'i/ /bka' drin thugs la smin pa'i me long du/ /mkhyen gnyis gzugs kyi skyed mched gsal zhing rdzogs/ 10 /rgyad sde rgya mtsho'i klong du gnas bcas pa/ sgodze'i dbang phyug gdengs ka phyar ba'i rtse'i/ /legs bshad nor bu 'bar bas 'od 'phreng gis/ /phyogs

kun rnam par snang mdzad nyid du byas/ 11 /gzhan yang grub pa'i sar bzhugs du ma'i gsung / /thugs kyi thig ler chags pa'i man ngag gi/ /gter mdzod skal ldan mdun du kha phye nas/ /gto pa med pa'i mchod sbyin 'gyed la dgazha/ 12 /lcang lo can zhes gdod nas dbang po'i grong khyer gli /khyab bdag phyag na mthu stobs rdo rje 'dzin pa'ang deng / /ras dkar na bza' can gyi rdo rje grags pa'i skur/ /bstan nas sngon med gdams pa'i snod du 'di nyid mdzad/ 'a /khyim spangs rab byung zhi ba'i nags 'dab bston bzhed kyang / /yab rje'i lung gis rgyal thabs chen por cod pan bcings/ /skyon gyis gang ba'i 'dam rdzab mi zad khol nang du/ /skyon bral 'dab yangs rdzogs pa'i pad+ma rnam rgyas bzhin/ 14 /sngal pa'i gar mkhan kurma pa/ /chos grags rgya mtshor 'khyil ba des/ /bsod nams bzhin du byin chags pa'i/ /
